repos.description: Reverse engineer anything with agents, from app behavior down to native binaries.
repos.summary_zh: REA 是基于 MCP 协议的逆向工程智能体框架，支持原生二进制、JavaScript/Electron 应用、.NET 程序集及网页的多平台分析。通过对接 Hopper、Ghidra、IDA 等专业工具，让 AI 智能体在本地完成代码审查与行为逆向，输出带证据链的结论，适用于竞品分析与安全研究。
repos.summary_en: REA is an MCP-based reverse engineering agent framework supporting multi-platform analysis of native binaries, JavaScript/Electron apps, .NET assemblies, and websites. It connects to Hopper, Ghidra, and IDA for local code inspection and behavioral reverse engineering with evidence-backed conclusions, ideal for competitive analysis and security research.

repos.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
repos.summary_zh: 一套面向真实工程的AI智能体技能库，提供可组合的提示词模板，解决需求对齐、代码啰嗦、调试低效等痛点。支持任意大模型，集成GitHub/Linear，助力工程师高效协作而非vibe coding。
repos.summary_en: A collection of composable AI agent skills for real engineering, solving misalignment, verbosity, and debugging inefficiencies. Works with any model, integrates with GitHub/Linear, and helps engineers collaborate effectively beyond vibe coding.

repos.description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
repos.summary_zh: ECC 是一个 AI 智能体性能优化系统，专为 Claude Code、Cursor、GitHub Copilot 等 AI 编程助手设计。系统提供技能管理、内存优化、安全扫描和研究优先开发框架，支持跨 harness 架构。从 Anthropic hackathon 胜出，经过 10+ 个月实战验证，支持 12+ 语言生态，可显著提升 AI 编程效率和质量。
repos.summary_en: ECC is a production-ready AI agent harness performance optimization system designed for Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and other AI coding assistants. It provides comprehensive capabilities including skills management, instincts, memory optimization, continuous learning, security scanning, and research-first development framework. Winner of Anthropic hackathon, battle-tested over 10+ months across 12+ language ecosystems with cross-harness architecture, dramatically improving AI coding efficiency and code quality.

repos.description: The open source coding agent.
repos.summary_zh: OpenCode是开源AI编程代理，提供终端与桌面双界面。支持多平台安装（macOS/Windows/Linux），集成多种包管理器。具备活跃社区与持续更新，为开发者提供智能编码辅助。
repos.summary_en: OpenCode is an open-source AI coding agent that delivers intelligent programming assistance through both terminal and desktop interfaces. It provides comprehensive multi-platform support for macOS, Windows, and Linux, with diverse installation options including npm, Homebrew, Scoop, Chocolatey, pacman, and direct shell scripts. The project maintains an active Discord community for real-time collaboration, offers beta desktop applications for enhanced user experience, ensures continuous updates, and respects XDG Base Directory Specification for flexible installation paths, providing developers with cutting-edge AI-powered coding capabilities across all development environments while maintaining high accessibility standards.

repos.description: Knowledge infrastructure to make your agents smarter. Search, scrape and 550+ data providers through one API.

repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: A complete AI agency at your fingertips - From frontend wizards to Reddit community ninjas, from whimsy injectors to reality checkers. Each agent is a specialized expert with personality, processes, and proven deliverables.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供一套生产就绪的AI代理团队，涵盖前端、后端、移动开发等专业领域。每个代理具备独特人格、专业工作流和可量化交付物，支持Claude Code、GitHub Copilot等主流工具。通过标准化提示工程与自动化脚本，将通用AI助手转化为具备领域专长的虚拟员工，实现软件开发全流程的智能化升级。
repos.summary_en: This repository delivers a production-ready AI agent team covering frontend, backend, mobile development, and more. Each agent features unique personality, specialized workflows, and measurable deliverables, compatible with Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and other mainstream tools. By standardizing prompt engineering with automation scripts, it transforms generic AI assistants into domain-specialized virtual employees, enabling intelligent upgrades across the entire software development lifecycle.

repos.description: Turn any codebase, with its docs, SQL schemas, configs, and PDFs, into a queryable knowledge graph. A /graphify skill for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI: local deterministic AST parsing, every edge explained, no vector store.
repos.summary_zh: Graphify 将任意代码库（含文档、SQL、PDF、图像、视频）转化为可查询知识图谱，作为 Claude Code、Cursor 等 17+ AI 编码助手的 /graphify 技能。本地 tree-sitter AST 确定性解析 36+ 语言代码，无 LLM 且数据不离机；每个边标注 EXTRACTED/INFERRED 确保透明。输出交互式 graph.html、GRAPH_REPORT.md 和 graph.json，支持路径查询、社区检测（Leiden），非向量存储。适用于新项目理解、PR 审查、团队 onboarding，大幅降低 AI token 消耗。
repos.summary_en: Graphify turns any codebase—including code, docs, SQL, configs, PDFs, images, and videos—into a queryable knowledge graph. It installs as a /graphify skill for 17+ AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and Gemini CLI. Code is parsed locally and deterministically via tree-sitter AST across 36+ languages with no LLM or data leaving the machine. Every edge is tagged EXTRACTED or INFERRED for auditability. It outputs interactive graph.html, a report, and graph.json for path queries, community detection, and concept exploration instead of vector stores or grepping. Ideal for onboarding, codebase navigation, PR reviews, and grounding AI responses with significant token savings.

repos.description: FULL Augment Code, Claude Code, Cluely, CodeBuddy, Comet, Cursor, Devin AI, Junie, Kiro, Leap.new, Lovable, Manus, NotionAI, Orchids.app, Perplexity, Poke, Qoder, Replit, Same.dev, Trae, Traycer AI, VSCode Agent, Warp.dev, Windsurf, Xcode, Z.ai Code, Dia & v0. (And other Open Sourced) System Prompts, Internal Tools & AI Models
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库逆向工程整理了30余款主流AI编程工具的系统提示词与内部机制，涵盖Cursor、Claude Code、Devin AI、Windsurf等核心产品。提供超过30,000行真实配置，为开发者、安全研究员和架构师提供罕见的AI代理架构底层洞察，适用于提示词工程优化、竞品分析和AI安全研究。
repos.summary_en: This repository reverse-engineers and aggregates system prompts and internal mechanisms from 30+ mainstream AI coding tools including Cursor, Claude Code, Devin AI, and Windsurf. With over 30,000 lines of actual configurations, it offers unprecedented insights into AI agent architectures for prompt engineering optimization, competitive analysis, and AI security research.

repos.description: A collection of DESIGN.md files analysis by popular brand design systems. Drop one into your project and let coding agents generate a matching UI.
repos.summary_zh: 精选55+个知名网站的DESIGN.md设计系统文档，为AI编码代理提供纯文本规范以生成像素级完美UI。完整定义视觉主题、色彩、排版、组件样式及响应式行为，无需Figma或JSON等复杂工具，显著提升AI驱动前端开发的效率与一致性。
repos.summary_en: A curated collection of 55+ DESIGN.md files from popular websites, capturing complete design systems in plain text. Enables AI coding agents to generate pixel-perfect UIs by defining visual themes, colors, typography, components, and responsive behavior. Eliminates Figma exports or JSON schemas, streamlining AI-powered frontend development with LLM-friendly markdown format.

repos.description: AI agent toolkit: unified LLM API, agent loop, TUI, coding agent CLI
repos.summary_zh: Pi 是一个自扩展的 AI 编码 Agent 工具链，提供统一的 LLM API 抽象层，支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 等多模型提供商。包含交互式 CLI、终端 UI 库和 Slack 机器人，具备工具调用和状态管理能力。专为开发者设计，通过真实开源项目会话数据持续优化，实现生产级 AI 自动化编程。
repos.summary_en: Pi is a self-extensible AI coding agent toolkit featuring a unified LLM API abstraction layer supporting multiple providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google. It includes an interactive CLI, terminal UI library with differential rendering, web UI components, and Slack bot integration with robust tool calling and state management capabilities. Designed for developers, it enables production-grade AI automation programming and continuously improves through real-world open-source session data collection and sharing, with hardened supply-chain security for enterprise deployment.

repos.description: Production-grade engineering skills for AI coding agents.
repos.summary_zh: Agent Skills 是为AI编程智能体打造的生产级工程技能库，将高级工程师的软件开发流程、质量门禁和最佳实践编码为标准化工作流。提供7个生命周期命令（/spec、/plan、/build等）和23个结构化技能，涵盖设计、开发到部署全流程。基于Markdown的提示工程实现自动化，支持Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini等多平台，确保AI代理在编码各阶段遵循一致的质量标准。
repos.summary_en: Agent Skills is a production-grade engineering skill pack for AI coding agents that codifies senior engineers' development workflows, quality gates, and best practices into standardized processes. It provides 7 lifecycle slash commands (/spec, /plan, /build, /test, /review, /code-simplify, /ship) and 23 structured skills covering the entire development lifecycle from design to production. Built on Markdown-based prompt engineering, it enables automated enforcement of code quality standards across platforms including Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, and GitHub Copilot.

repos.description: Agent skills that give coding agents taste: art direction, reference images and a browser check instead of generic AI pages
repos.summary_zh: Taste-Skill 是一个开源反“slop”前端框架，专为AI智能体设计。通过可移植的SKILL.md技能文件，指导Cursor、Claude Code、Codex等代理生成优质界面，强化布局、排版、动效与间距，避免通用模板。该仓库提供多种风格技能（极简、粗犷等）、redesign审计、图像到代码流程，以及网页/移动端/品牌套件图像生成技能。支持npx skills add安装、可调设计参数（方差、动效、密度），兼容多框架与AI工具，助力打造高端非模板化前端。
repos.summary_en: Taste-Skill is an open-source anti-slop frontend framework for AI agents. It provides portable SKILL.md files that guide coding agents like Cursor, Claude Code, and Codex to generate premium interfaces with refined layout, typography, motion, and spacing instead of generic boilerplate. The repo includes style-specific skills, redesign audits, image-to-code pipelines, and image-generation skills for web/mobile/brand reference boards. Installable via npx skills add with adjustable dials (variance, motion, density), it works across frameworks and AI tools to deliver high-quality, non-templated frontends.

repos.description: The open-source app everyone uses to manage agents at work
repos.summary_zh: Paperclip 是一个开源的 AI 代理编排平台，用于构建"零人力公司"。它通过 Node.js 服务端和 React 管理界面，协调多个 AI 代理（如 Claude、Cursor 等）协同完成商业目标。核心功能包括组织架构管理、预算控制、目标对齐和任务追踪，让管理者像使用任务管理器一样 overseeing 整个 AI 团队。平台支持任意能接收心跳信号的代理，提供统一仪表盘监控工作进展和成本，实现 24/7 自动化运营，同时保留人工审计和干预能力。
repos.summary_en: Paperclip is an open-source orchestration platform for building "zero-human companies." It coordinates teams of AI agents through a Node.js backend and React dashboard, enabling autonomous business operations. The platform provides organizational charts, budget governance, goal alignment, and cost tracking across multiple agents like Claude Code and Cursor. Supporting any agent that can receive heartbeats, it functions as a task manager for AI teams, allowing 24/7 autonomous execution with human oversight. Users can define business goals, assign AI roles, and monitor progress from a unified interface, with pre-built company templates coming soon.

repos.description: The design vocabulary for your coding agent. Steer with polish and bolder, review with critique and audit, catch AI slop before it ships.
repos.summary_zh: Impeccable是为AI编码助手打造的UI设计增强系统，解决LLM生成界面同质化、缺乏专业性的问题。通过7大领域设计知识库（排版、色彩、动效等）、17个专用指令（/audit、/polish、/animate等）及反模式约束，显著提升AI设计输出质量。支持Cursor等IDE，提供从技术审查到视觉优化的全流程设计指导，让AI成为真正懂设计的前端协作伙伴。
repos.summary_en: Impeccable is a UI design enhancement system for AI coding assistants that addresses generic, low-quality LLM-generated interfaces. It provides 7 domain-specific design knowledge bases (typography, color, motion, etc.), 17 steering commands (/audit, /polish, /animate), and curated anti-patterns to significantly improve AI design output. Integrated with IDEs like Cursor, it offers end-to-end design guidance from technical auditing to visual optimization, transforming AI into a design-savvy frontend collaborator.

repos.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
repos.summary_zh: Agent-Reach 为 AI 智能体提供命令行式全网接入，支持 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、B站、小红书等平台，自动处理认证与反爬，零 API 费用实现跨平台内容读取与搜索。
repos.summary_en: Agent-Reach is a CLI tool that equips AI agents with cross-platform internet access across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, Bilibili, and XiaoHongShu. It automatically handles authentication, anti-bot measures, and data cleaning—zero API fees, one command to install.

repos.description: The 1st Collaborative AI Design Agent Workspace. Local-first and open source. Create motion, prototypes, websites, apps, dashboards, presentations, images, and videos with your team and AI agents. Share work, exchange feedback, and iterate together in one workspace.
repos.summary_zh: Open Design 是开源、本地优先的 Claude Design 替代品，支持 16+ AI 编码代理（Claude Code/Cursor/Gemini 等）。提供 31 种可组合技能和 72 个品牌级设计系统，可生成 Web/桌面/移动原型、幻灯片、图像和视频，支持 HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4 导出。BYOK 模式确保数据自主，沙盒预览保障安全，是 Figma 的开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Open Design is an open-source, local-first alternative to Claude Design supporting 16+ AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini, etc.). It offers 31 composable skills and 72 brand-grade design systems to generate web, desktop, and mobile prototypes, slides, images, and videos. Features include sandboxed preview, HTML/PDF/PPTX/MP4 export, and BYOK (Bring Your Own Key) model for data sovereignty. A viable open-source replacement for Figma with multi-agent flexibility.

repos.description: Turn any idea, plan, or codebase into a beautiful interactive diagram. An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex, and more.
repos.summary_zh: Archify 是一款 AI 代理技能工具，能将自然语言描述转化为精美的架构图、工作流图、序列图、数据流图和生命周期图。生成自包含 HTML，支持暗/亮主题一键切换、剪贴板复制及最高 4 倍原生分辨率导出（PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG）。SVG 支持系统主题偏好。集成 Claude 等平台，无需设计技能，通过聊天指令迭代优化。核心价值是提升技术文档和可视化效率，适用于系统架构、DevOps 流程及数据管道等场景。
repos.summary_en: Archify is an agent skill for AI tools like Claude that generates high-quality architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams from plain English text. It outputs self-contained HTML files featuring instant dark/light theme toggles, clipboard PNG copy, and native 4× resolution exports in PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG. SVGs include dual themes with media queries for automatic adaptation. Requiring no design expertise, it supports conversational refinements and is ideal for technical documentation, system design, CI/CD pipelines, and data engineering visualizations.

repos.description: Graphs that teach > graphs that impress. Turn any code into an interactive knowledge graph you can explore, search, and ask questions about. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, Gemini CLI, and more.
repos.summary_zh: Understand Anything 通过多智能体流水线分析代码库，结合 Tree-sitter 结构解析与 LLM 语义理解，构建文件、函数、类及依赖的交互式知识图谱。支持结构视图与业务领域视图切换，提供语义搜索、引导游览、影响分析和多语言支持。兼容 Claude Code、Cursor、Copilot 等 AI 编码工具，帮助开发者快速掌握大型代码库架构与业务逻辑，加速 onboarding 与代码探索。
repos.summary_en: Understand Anything uses a multi-agent pipeline combining tree-sitter parsing and LLMs to turn any codebase into an interactive knowledge graph of files, functions, classes, and dependencies. It offers structural and business domain views, semantic search, guided tours, and impact analysis. Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and more, it helps developers quickly understand complex projects, aiding onboarding and AI-assisted coding.

repos.description: Official Crawl4AI Cloud: a hosted web scraping, extraction, and search API for AI agents. Free API key, 1,000 credits a month, no card. Fully open source: this repo is the Apache-2.0 crawler that powers it, and you can self-host it.
repos.summary_zh: Crawl4AI 是一款开源的LLM友好型网页爬虫，专为RAG、AI代理和数据管道设计。它将网页转换为干净的Markdown格式，便于大语言模型处理。项目亮点包括：崩溃恢复机制支持长时间深度爬取；预取模式提升5-10倍URL发现速度；提供自托管平台，含企业级监控仪表板和REST API；采用浏览器池管理技术。拥有5万+星标社区验证，相比现有方案显著降低成本，支持完全本地化部署。
repos.summary_en: Crawl4AI is an open-source, LLM-friendly web crawler designed for RAG, AI agents, and data pipelines. It converts web content into clean Markdown format optimized for language models. Key features include crash recovery for long-running deep crawls, prefetch mode for 5-10x faster URL discovery, and a self-hosting platform with enterprise-grade monitoring dashboard, REST API, and WebSocket streaming. Battle-tested by a 50k+ star community, it offers a cost-effective alternative to paid solutions with full local deployment capabilities and smart browser pool management.

repos.description: 📚 《从零开始构建智能体》——从零开始的智能体原理与实践教程
repos.summary_zh: Datawhale 开源项目《从零开始构建智能体》提供系统性 AI Native Agent 开发教程，填补市场实践空白。内容涵盖智能体核心原理、经典范式（ReAct/Plan-and-Solve）、自研框架 HelloAgents、模型训练（SFT/GRPO）及多智能体实战案例。从理论到代码实现，帮助开发者从 LLM 使用者转型为智能体系统构建者。
repos.summary_en: Datawhale's 'Hello-Agents' delivers a comprehensive, hands-on tutorial for building AI Native Agents from first principles, filling the gap in systematic Agent development resources. The curriculum spans core architectures, classic paradigms (ReAct, Plan-and-Solve, Reflection), low-code platforms (Coze/Dify), mainstream frameworks (AutoGen/LangGraph), self-developed HelloAgents framework, model training (SFT/GRPO), and production-ready projects like intelligent travel assistants. Designed to transform LLM users into proficient Agent system architects through practical implementation.

repos.description: An open-source long-horizon SuperAgent harness that researches, codes, and creates. With the help of sandboxes, memories, tools, skill, subagents and message gateway, it handles different levels of tasks that could take minutes to hours.
repos.summary_zh: DeerFlow 是字节跳动开源的超级智能体框架，通过协调子智能体、记忆系统和沙箱环境，处理分钟级到小时级的复杂研究与创作任务。其核心在于可扩展技能体系与上下文工程，支持长期记忆持久化与文件系统操作，为构建自主智能体应用提供生产级基础设施。
repos.summary_en: DeerFlow is an open-source SuperAgent harness by Bytedance that orchestrates sub-agents, memory, and sandboxes to handle complex research, coding, and creative tasks spanning minutes to hours. Featuring extensible skills, context engineering, and long-term memory persistence, it provides production-grade infrastructure for building autonomous agent applications.

repos.description: Compress tool outputs, logs, files, and RAG chunks before they reach the LLM. 20% fewer tokens for coding agents, 60-95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. Library, proxy, MCP server.
repos.summary_zh: Headroom 是 AI 智能体的上下文压缩层，能压缩工具输出、日志、RAG 块和文件，减少 60-95% 令牌并保持答案质量。提供 Python/TS 库、代理和 MCP 服务器，支持 Claude、Cursor 等集成。具备可逆 CCR 压缩、跨代理内存共享和失败学习等功能，支持 6 种算法，本地优先，显著提升 LLM 交互效率。
repos.summary_en: Headroom acts as the context optimization layer for LLM applications and AI agents. It compresses tool outputs, logs, RAG chunks, files, DB results, and more before they reach the model, achieving 60-95% token reduction while preserving 100% answer accuracy. Deployable as a Python or TypeScript library, transparent proxy, MCP server, or integrations with LangChain, Agno, Vercel AI SDK, and 100+ LLM providers. Key highlights include reversible CCR compression, smart content detection across formats, persistent hierarchical memory, failure learning that updates agent docs, image compression via ML, cache optimization, and six specialized algorithms. Local-first and multi-agent compatible, it drastically cuts costs and latency for LLM interactions.

repos.description: Learn AI Engineering! Learn it. Build it. Ship it for others.
repos.summary_zh: 《AI工程从零开始》是开源AI工程课程，含473课、20阶段、约320小时。从数学基础到多智能体系统与生产，覆盖Python等多语言。核心是每算法从原始数学手工构建，再用框架对比，每课产出提示、技能、代理或MCP服务器等可复用产物。填补工具使用与专业准备差距，帮助深入掌握AI internals，免费MIT许可，配网站与技能集成，适合开发者实战学习与构建系统。
repos.summary_en: AI Engineering from Scratch is a comprehensive open-source curriculum with 473 lessons across 20 phases (~320 hours). It spans math foundations to deep learning, transformers, LLMs built from scratch, agent engineering, multi-agent swarms, production, and ethics. Learners implement algorithms from raw math in Python, TypeScript, Rust, and Julia before frameworks. Every lesson ships reusable artifacts: prompts, skills, agents, MCP servers. Emphasizes deep understanding over API calls. Free MIT license with website and agent skills for personalized paths.

repos.description: Open-source AI penetration testing tool to find and fix your app’s vulnerabilities.
repos.summary_zh: Strix 是一款开源的 AI 安全代理工具，通过模拟真实黑客行为动态扫描应用漏洞。核心亮点包括：团队协作模式实现高效漏洞挖掘、生成可验证的 PoC 而非误报、提供一键自动修复方案，并支持 CI/CD 集成。适用于快速渗透测试、Bug 赏金自动化和应用安全测试，大幅提升安全测试效率。
repos.summary_en: Strix is an open-source AI-powered security agent that simulates real hackers to dynamically discover and validate application vulnerabilities. Key features include: collaborative agent teams for efficient scanning, real PoC generation eliminating false positives, one-click autofix capabilities, and seamless CI/CD integration. Ideal for rapid penetration testing, bug bounty automation, and application security testing, dramatically accelerating security remediation.

repos.description: A coding-agent skill for multi-phase security audits with independently verified, machine-readable findings
repos.summary_zh: 该技能将编码代理转化为安全审计员，通过侦察、覆盖驱动狩猎、候选验证、结构化输出、独立记录验证和中性报告六阶段，生成机器可读且经独立验证的安全发现，适用于代码库安全审计与漏洞挖掘。
repos.summary_en: This skill turns a coding agent into a security auditor, orchestrating six phases—reconnaissance, coverage-led hunting, candidate validation, structured output, independent record verification, and target-neutral reporting—to produce machine-readable, independently verified findings for codebase security audits and vulnerability discovery.

repos.description: Unified Efficient Fine-Tuning of 100+ LLMs & VLMs (ACL 2024)
repos.summary_zh: LlamaFactory是一个统一的大语言模型与多模态模型高效微调框架，支持100+预训练模型。提供零代码命令行工具和基于Gradio的Web UI，大幅降低微调门槛。该框架在ACL 2024发表，已被Amazon、NVIDIA、阿里云等企业采用，支持云端部署和本地训练，集成LoRA、QLoRA等高效微调技术，是学术界和工业界广泛使用的微调解决方案。
repos.summary_en: LlamaFactory is a unified framework for efficient fine-tuning of 100+ large language and vision-language models. It offers zero-code CLI and Gradio-powered Web UI, dramatically lowering the barrier to model customization. Published at ACL 2024 and adopted by industry leaders including Amazon, NVIDIA, and Aliyun, it supports both cloud deployment and local training. The framework integrates advanced parameter-efficient techniques like LoRA and QLoRA, making it a widely-used solution for streamlined model adaptation in academic and industrial settings.

repos.description: AI agent skill that researches any topic across Reddit, X, YouTube, HN, Polymarket, and the web - then synthesizes a grounded summary
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个Claude Code插件，AI智能体技能，自动抓取过去30天内Reddit、X、YouTube等8大社交平台及网页内容，通过多信号质量排名算法和跨源收敛检测，生成基于真实引用的趋势摘要。支持对比模式分析技术选型，自动保存研究简报，帮助开发者快速掌握AI领域最新动态。
repos.summary_en: A Claude Code plugin that automatically researches topics across 8 social platforms including Reddit, X, YouTube, Bluesky, TikTok, Instagram, Hacker News, and Polymarket from the last 30 days. It employs multi-signal quality-ranked relevance scoring, cross-platform convergence detection, and composite ranking algorithms to synthesize grounded narratives with real citations. Features include comparative mode for side-by-side analysis, automatic saving of research briefings, smart subreddit discovery, and per-project configuration. Helps developers stay current with AI trends and community discussions.

repos.description: Editorial diagram design for Claude Code, Codex, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Factory Droid, Qoder, and Pi. 45 diagram types. Self-contained HTML + SVG. No shadows. No Mermaid slop.
repos.summary_zh: 专为Claude Code、Codex、Pi等AI智能体打造的编辑级图表技能。输出纯自包含HTML+SVG，无阴影、无Mermaid粗糙样式，支持架构、流程、序列、Sankey、Wardley等数十种专业类型。可读取网站自动匹配品牌色与字体，默认静态输出，可选无障碍动画，并能重绘draw.io/Mermaid/Excalidraw源图。强调极简密度与焦点设计，让AI生成图表真正达到设计师水准。
repos.summary_en: Editorial diagram skill for Claude Code, Codex, Pi and Agent Skills hosts. Produces self-contained HTML+SVG with no shadows or Mermaid-style clutter. Supports architecture, flowcharts, sequences, Sankey, Wardley maps and dozens more types. Auto-matches brand colors/fonts from your site in seconds. Static by default with optional accessible motion; redraws draw.io, Mermaid or Excalidraw sources. Delivers clean, designer-approved visuals with deliberate low density and focal accents.

repos.description: Warp is an agentic development environment, born out of the terminal.
repos.summary_zh: Warp 是一款诞生于终端的智能体开发环境，深度集成 AI 编码助手并支持 Claude Code 等第三方 CLI 智能体。其 Oz 系统可自动化处理开源项目的 issue 管理、PR 审查等协作流程，提供实时智能体会话追踪与贡献者仪表板。采用 AGPL 开源协议，重塑开发者与 AI 协同编程体验。
repos.summary_en: Warp is an agentic development environment born from the terminal, deeply integrating AI coding assistants and supporting third-party CLI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. Its proprietary Oz system automates open-source project workflows including issue triage, PR reviews, spec writing, and community management. The platform provides real-time agent session tracking via build.warp.dev and comprehensive contributor dashboards. With OpenAI as founding sponsor and GPT-powered agentic workflows, Warp redefines developer-AI collaboration under AGPL open-source licensing while offering an MIT-licensed UI framework.

repos.description: A light-weight and powerful meta-prompting, context engineering and spec-driven development system for Claude Code by TÂCHES.
repos.summary_zh: 针对Claude Code的轻量级元提示与上下文工程系统，通过结构化提示管理和规范驱动开发流程，显著提升AI编程效率。核心价值在于将复杂提示工程标准化，优化大模型上下文窗口利用率，实现可复用的开发模式。适用于AI辅助开发场景，需注意项目已迁移至open-gsd/get-shit-done-redux。
repos.summary_en: GSD (Get Shit Done) is a lightweight meta-prompting and context engineering framework built exclusively for Claude Code, designed to maximize AI programming efficiency. It introduces structured prompt management and specification-driven development workflows that standardize complex prompt engineering tasks. The system optimizes LLM context window utilization through dynamic context orchestration and enables reusable development patterns with prompt versioning capabilities. By enforcing spec-based validation, it ensures consistent AI behavior and high-quality output. This powerful tool transforms chaotic AI-assisted development into a systematic, productive process, reducing prompt sprawl and context management overhead. Note: This repository is archived; active development continues at open-gsd/get-shit-done-redux.

repos.description: Marketing skills for Claude Code and AI agents. CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是一个专为AI编码代理设计的营销技能集合，以Markdown文件形式提供CRO、文案写作、SEO、数据分析和增长工程等专业工作流。基于Agent Skills规范构建，技能相互引用并以product-marketing为基础，提供产品、受众与定位上下文。适用于Claude Code、Cursor等工具，帮助技术营销者和创始人通过AI代理实现营销任务自动化与优化。
repos.summary_en: This repository delivers a curated collection of markdown-based skills for AI coding agents, specializing in CRO, copywriting, SEO, analytics, and growth engineering. Built to the Agent Skills spec, skills interconnect with product-marketing as the foundational layer providing product, audience, and positioning context. It empowers technical marketers and founders using Claude Code, Cursor, and similar agents to automate and optimize marketing workflows efficiently.

repos.description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
repos.summary_zh: CLI-Anything 通过自动化生成命令行接口，让任意软件 instantly 具备 AI 智能体原生调用能力。项目基于 Click 框架解析源码与 GUI，自动生成支持 JSON 结构化输出、撤销/重做和 REPL 的 CLI，无缝集成 Claude Code、Cursor 等主流 AI 编程助手，解决了 AI 控制存量软件的最后一公里问题，实现确定性、可组合的智能体工作流。
repos.summary_en: CLI-Anything revolutionizes software interaction by auto-generating command-line interfaces that make any application instantly accessible to AI agents. Built on Python's Click framework, it analyzes source code and GUI structures to create composable CLIs with structured JSON output, undo/redo capabilities, and REPL modes. Seamlessly integrating with Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI coding assistants, it bridges the critical gap between AI agents and legacy software, enabling deterministic, reliable agent-native workflows across diverse tools.

repos.description: DeepTutor: Lifelong Personalized Tutoring. https://deeptutor.info/.
repos.summary_zh: DeepTutor 是港大数据科学实验室推出的终身个性化智能辅导系统，基于大语言模型构建，提供 macOS 与 Windows 桌面应用。它支持多语言交互，通过个性化学习路径与持续反馈，帮助学生实现长期知识掌握与能力提升，是 AI 赋能教育领域的开源实践。
repos.summary_en: DeepTutor is a lifelong personalized tutoring system developed by HKUDS, powered by large language models. Available as cross-platform desktop apps for macOS and Windows, it supports multilingual interaction and delivers adaptive learning paths with continuous feedback, enabling students to achieve long-term knowledge mastery—an open-source practice in AI-driven education.

repos.description: The open-source AI voice studio. Clone, dictate, create.
repos.summary_zh: Voicebox 是一款开源本地AI语音工作室，提供语音克隆、多语言TTS和全局听写功能。支持7大引擎、23种语言，零样本克隆声音，具备后处理与表达性控制。完全离线运行保障隐私，集成故事编辑器与AI代理语音交互，是 ElevenLabs 与 WisprFlow 的开源替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Voicebox is an open-source, local-first AI voice studio that enables voice cloning from seconds of audio and speech generation in 23 languages across 7 TTS engines. It provides zero-shot voice cloning, expressive speech with paralinguistic tags, post-processing effects, and unlimited-length content creation. Key features include global dictation hotkeys, multi-track timeline editing for podcasts, and voice-enabled AI agent interaction via local LLM integration. Running entirely offline ensures complete privacy, making it a comprehensive free alternative to ElevenLabs and WisprFlow.

repos.description: Skills for Designers and Engineers.
repos.summary_zh: emilkowalski/skills 仓库为设计工程师与 AI 智能体提供专业技能库，专注用户界面动画与设计决策优化。基于 Vercel 和 Linear 实战经验，技能帮助 AI 避免缓动函数错误、阴影选择不当等常见品味问题，包含 emil-design-eng 核心指导、动画审查、精确动画词汇及 Apple 流畅运动原则等模块。通过 skills.sh CLI 快速安装，为 AI 代理注入专家品味，是生成精美流畅界面的高效快捷方式。
repos.summary_en: The emilkowalski/skills repository delivers curated skills for design engineers and AI agents to build superior user interfaces with emphasis on animations and design decisions. Drawing from experience at Vercel and Linear, these skills equip agents with professional taste to avoid pitfalls like incorrect easing or suboptimal visual choices. Modules include emil-design-eng for core guidance, strict animation reviews, precise vocabulary, and Apple-inspired motion principles. Installable via the skills.sh CLI, it offers a shortcut to polished, expert-level UI outputs from AI agents.

repos.description: Breakthrough Method for Agile Ai Driven Development
repos.summary_zh: BMad Method是开源AI驱动敏捷开发框架，通过12+专业AI智能体（PM、架构师、开发者、UX等）模拟真实团队协作。采用结构化工作流，基于敏捷实践实现规模自适应，从bug修复到企业系统自动调整规划深度。支持Party Mode多代理讨论、bmad-help智能指导、完整生命周期及Claude Code等AI IDE集成。提供模块扩展、技能架构和V6跨平台优化，强调AI作为专家协作者引导最佳思考，而非自主输出。适用于solo开发者至企业团队，100%免费开源。
repos.summary_en: BMad Method is an open-source AI-driven agile development framework featuring 12+ specialized AI agents (PM, Architect, Developer, UX, etc.) that act as expert collaborators in structured workflows. It is scale-adaptive, automatically adjusting planning depth from bug fixes to enterprise systems based on agile best practices. Key highlights include Party Mode for multi-agent collaboration, bmad-help guidance, full lifecycle coverage from ideation to deployment, and seamless integration with AI IDEs like Claude Code and Cursor. With modules for testing and more, plus V6 enhancements in cross-platform teams and skills architecture, it empowers superior results through guided AI partnership. 100% free and open-source.

repos.description: Your AI workspace for models, agents, and productivity.
repos.summary_zh: Cherry Studio 是一款 AI 生产力桌面应用，集成智能聊天与自主代理能力，内置 300+ 专业助手。通过统一接口无缝接入 GPT-4、Claude 等前沿大模型，支持多语言交互与上下文感知，覆盖文档处理、代码生成、研究分析等场景，实现智能化升级并显著提升工作效率。
repos.summary_en: Cherry Studio is a comprehensive AI productivity desktop application that seamlessly integrates intelligent chat interfaces with autonomous agent capabilities, featuring over 300 specialized assistants for various domains. The platform provides unified access to leading large language models including GPT-4 and Claude, supports multilingual interactions with advanced context awareness, enables intelligent automation across document processing, code generation, and research analysis scenarios, and offers a user-friendly interface for both technical and non-technical users, significantly enhancing workplace productivity and operational efficiency through streamlined workflows.

repos.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
repos.summary_zh: Vercel Labs推出的AI代理浏览器自动化CLI工具，基于Rust构建提供毫秒级响应。核心亮点是通过无障碍树引用(@e1)实现AI友好的元素定位，支持点击、填充、截图等操作，为AI代理提供高效网页交互能力。
repos.summary_en: Rust CLI for AI browser automation with sub-millisecond speed. Features accessibility tree references (@e1) for AI-friendly element interaction, including clicks, form fills, and screenshots.

repos.description: Qlib is an AI-oriented Quant investment platform that aims to use AI tech to empower Quant Research, from exploring ideas to implementing productions. Qlib supports diverse ML modeling paradigms, including supervised learning, market dynamics modeling, and RL, and is now equipped with https://github.com/microsoft/RD-Agent to automate R&D process.
repos.summary_zh: Qlib是微软开源的AI驱动量化投资平台，旨在用AI技术赋能量化研究全流程。平台支持监督学习、强化学习等多种机器学习范式，并集成RD-Agent实现因子挖掘与模型优化的自动化研发。适用于从策略构思到生产部署的全场景，提供跨平台支持，助力量化投资智能化升级。
repos.summary_en: Qlib is Microsoft's open-source AI-powered quantitative investment platform designed to empower the entire quant research workflow with AI technology. The platform supports diverse ML paradigms including supervised learning, market dynamics modeling, and reinforcement learning. It integrates RD-Agent, an LLM-based autonomous framework that automates factor mining and model optimization. Suitable for scenarios ranging from strategy ideation to production deployment, Qlib offers cross-platform support and accelerates intelligent transformation in quantitative investing.

repos.description: Your lightweight open-source personal agent.
repos.summary_zh: nanobot 是 HKUDS 开发的开源超轻量级 AI 智能体，核心设计精简且可读。它支持聊天通道、记忆管理和 MCP 协议，可无缝集成工具与工作流。内置 WebUI，提供跨轮次目标追踪和图像生成能力，支持多模型 fallback。从本地快速部署到长期运行的个性化智能体，适用于自动化任务和智能助手场景。
repos.summary_en: nanobot is an open-source, ultra-lightweight AI agent developed by HKUDS, featuring a minimalist and readable core design. It supports chat channels, memory management, and the MCP protocol for seamless tool and workflow integration. With a built-in WebUI, it offers cross-turn goal tracking and end-to-end image generation, along with multi-model fallback support. Designed for easy deployment from local setups to long-running personal agents, it is ideal for automation tasks and intelligent assistant applications.

repos.description: 3,000+ reusable AI agent skills for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI. AAS Core adds local catalog discovery, agent-owned selection and plan preview. CLI, MCP and plugins.
repos.summary_zh: Agentic Awesome Skills 是一个可安装的 GitHub 库，汇集 1936+ 个 agentic skills，专为 Claude Code、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码助手设计。提供 SKILL.md 结构化剧本、插件、捆绑包和工作流，支持编码、调试、测试、安全审查等任务。通过 npm 安装器实现多工具兼容，强化提示工程应用，提升 AI 代理上下文与输出质量，是社区驱动的 AI 开发自动化核心资源。
repos.summary_en: Agentic Awesome Skills is an installable GitHub library with 1,936+ reusable agentic skills for AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, and Gemini CLI. It delivers structured SKILL.md playbooks, plugins, bundles, and workflows for coding, debugging, testing, and security tasks. Featuring an npm installer and multi-tool compatibility, it strengthens prompt engineering to improve AI agent context and outputs, serving as a community hub for AI-assisted development automation.

repos.description: Self-evolving Context Database for AI Agents. Unify Agent Memory, Knowledge RAG and Skills.
repos.summary_zh: OpenViking是专为AI Agent设计的开源上下文数据库，创新性地采用文件系统范式统一管理记忆、资源与技能，解决碎片化问题。核心亮点包括：L0/L1/L2分层加载大幅降低token成本；目录递归检索结合语义搜索提升精度；检索轨迹可视化打破RAG黑盒；自动会话管理实现上下文自演进。
repos.summary_en: OpenViking is an open-source context database designed for AI Agents. It unifies memory, resources, and skills via a filesystem paradigm. Key features include tiered loading (L0/L1/L2) to reduce token consumption, directory-recursive retrieval for improved precision, visualized retrieval trajectories for full observability, and automatic session management enabling self-evolving, adaptive context.

repos.description: Lightpanda: the headless browser designed for AI and automation
repos.summary_zh: Lightpanda 是为 AI 和自动化设计的开源无头浏览器，内存占用仅为 Chrome 的 1/9，执行速度快 11 倍。支持 JavaScript 和主流自动化框架，适用于网页爬虫、AI 代理和测试场景。
repos.summary_en: Lightpanda is an open-source headless browser designed specifically for AI and automation tasks. It dramatically reduces memory usage by 9x compared to Chrome while delivering 11x faster execution speeds. The browser supports JavaScript execution and Web APIs, and maintains compatibility with popular automation frameworks like Playwright, Puppeteer, and chromedp through the Chrome DevTools Protocol, making it ideal for web scraping, AI agent training, and automated testing.

repos.description: An open-source coding agent for your terminal, written in Rust. It works with any model, can split one task across several agents, and every line of it is yours to read.
repos.summary_zh: Codewhale 是一款开源终端 AI 编程智能体，基于 Rust 构建，支持任意大模型（云端或本地）。它能自主读取项目、编辑文件、执行命令并自我校验，提供交互式 TUI、无头模式及 PR 审查等多种运行方式，适用于自动化代码修复与开发者效率提升。
repos.summary_en: Codewhale is an open-source terminal-based AI coding agent built in Rust, supporting any LLM provider (hosted or local). It autonomously reads projects, edits files, runs commands, and self-verifies results. Offers interactive TUI, headless CI mode, and PR review for developer productivity.

repos.description: 📑 PageIndex: Document Index for Vectorless, Reasoning-based RAG
repos.summary_zh: PageIndex 是一个创新的向量无关、基于推理的 RAG 系统，专为专业长文档设计。它摒弃传统向量数据库和分块策略，通过构建层次化树形索引并模拟人类专家推理过程，实现上下文感知的智能检索。核心优势在于将相似度搜索升级为相关性推理，支持视觉基础 OCR 自由的工作流，并提供 MCP 集成，显著提升复杂文档的检索准确性与深度理解能力。
repos.summary_en: PageIndex is a vectorless, reasoning-based RAG framework designed for professional long documents. It replaces traditional vector databases and chunking with a hierarchical tree index, enabling LLMs to perform agentic, human-like retrieval through tree search reasoning. By prioritizing relevance over similarity, it supports OCR-free vision-based workflows and MCP integration, delivering superior accuracy for domain-intensive document analysis.

repos.description: Turn Claude Code into a full game dev studio — 49 AI agents, 75 workflow skills, and a complete coordination system mirroring real studio hierarchy.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目将Claude Code转变为完整的游戏开发工作室，包含48个专业化AI智能体、37个工作流程和8个自动化钩子。通过模拟真实游戏公司的三层管理架构（总监-部门主管-专员），为独立开发者提供结构化的团队协作体验。核心价值在于建立质量关卡、设计评审和标准化流程，确保从创意到发布的全程规范性，同时保持人类决策权。
repos.summary_en: This project transforms Claude Code into a complete game development studio with 48 specialized AI agents, 37 workflow commands, and 8 automation hooks. It mirrors real studio hierarchy across three tiers (Directors, Department Leads, Specialists) using Anthropic's Opus/Sonnet/Haiku models. The system provides structured team collaboration for solo developers, featuring quality gates, design reviews, and enforced coding standards. It maintains human decision-making while adding automated validation, sprint planning, and documentation generation throughout the development lifecycle from brainstorming to launch.

repos.description: The open agent skills tool - npx skills
repos.summary_zh: Vercel开源的AI智能体技能管理工具，支持54+主流编码助手。通过CLI一键安装GitHub/GitLab/本地技能包，支持项目级与全局部署，可精准指定目标智能体与技能，提供交互式与CI/CD友好模式。
repos.summary_en: Vercel's CLI for AI agent skills. Installs prompts across 54+ coding assistants from GitHub/GitLab/local. Supports project/global scope & CI/CD.

repos.description: Playwright MCP server
repos.summary_zh: Playwright MCP是微软推出的Model Context Protocol服务器，通过Playwright可访问性树为LLM提供浏览器自动化能力。它摒弃截图方案，采用结构化快照实现确定性操作，适用于探索性测试、自愈脚本和长周期自治工作流。相比CLI工具，MCP模式更适合需要持久状态和深度页面推理的智能体场景。
repos.summary_en: Playwright MCP is a Microsoft Model Context Protocol server that enables LLMs to automate browsers through Playwright's accessibility tree. It replaces screenshot-based approaches with structured snapshots for deterministic, vision-free interactions. Designed for exploratory automation, self-healing tests, and persistent autonomous workflows, it maintains continuous browser context at the cost of higher token usage. The server integrates seamlessly with MCP-compatible clients including VS Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop, and Windsurf, providing a lightweight yet powerful bridge between language models and web automation with rich introspection capabilities.

repos.description: The Open-Source Multimodal AI Agent Stack: Connecting Cutting-Edge AI Models and Agent Infra
repos.summary_zh: UI-TARS-desktop是字节跳动开源的多模态AI智能体桌面应用，基于UI-TARS视觉模型实现GUI自动化操作。支持本地与远程计算机及浏览器控制，无缝集成MCP工具链，通过自然语言指令完成跨应用任务。提供CLI与Web UI双模式，具备流式响应、运行时调试和沙箱隔离等企业级特性，为生产力自动化提供端到端解决方案。
repos.summary_en: UI-TARS-desktop is ByteDance's open-source multimodal AI agent desktop application powered by the UI-TARS vision model for GUI automation. It enables local and remote control of computers and browsers through natural language commands, seamlessly integrating with MCP tools for human-like task completion. Offering both CLI and Web UI interfaces, it features streaming responses, runtime performance statistics, Event Stream Viewer for debugging, and AIO Sandbox isolation. This enterprise-ready stack delivers a complete end-to-end solution for automating productivity workflows across desktop and web environments.

repos.description: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.
repos.summary_zh: Magpie 是跨平台本地网关，统一管理 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码智能体的模型配置。支持多供应商切换与配额耗尽自动故障转移，提供菜单栏、TUI、Web UI 及 CLI 界面，实现任意智能体与任意模型的灵活组合。
repos.summary_en: Magpie is a cross-platform local gateway that centralizes model configuration for multiple AI coding agents including Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI. It supports multi-provider switching, automatic failover when quotas are exhausted, and provides menu bar, TUI, Web UI, and CLI interfaces. Developers can flexibly pair any agent with any model across macOS, Windows, Linux, Docker, and Termux environments. One unified app manages all agent configs, provider keys, and routing rules, ensuring seamless model switching without manual intervention or downtime.

repos.description: Craft Anything: understand how any software works, and craft your own.
repos.summary_zh: Craft Anything 是一款纯 Rust 编写的开源逆向工程与 AI 克隆引擎。它能深入分析任意网站、应用或游戏的运行机制，借助真实检查工具研究原始实现，再让 AI 编码代理生成新项目，并自动比对结果、迭代优化，最终产出功能一致的替代版本。跨平台支持桌面与 Web。
repos.summary_en: Craft Anything is an open-source, clean-room engine written in pure Rust that reverse-engineers any website, app, or game. It studies the original with real inspection tools, has an AI coding agent build a new project, then checks the result against the original and iteratively refines it to produce a functionally equivalent clone. Cross-platform for desktop and web.

repos.description: "Vibe-Trading: Your Personal Trading Agent"
repos.summary_zh: Vibe-Trading 是港大开源的个人AI交易代理系统，通过单一命令赋予智能体完整交易能力。采用Python 3.11+与FastAPI后端、React 19前端，支持MCP协议实现模型交互。核心亮点包括Swarm集群容错恢复、影子账户模拟交易、Rich交互式CLI。提供API与MCP服务，支持实时任务协调与状态管理，为量化交易提供开箱即用的AI解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Vibe-Trading is HKU's open-source personal AI trading agent system that empowers agents with comprehensive trading capabilities through a single command. Built with Python 3.11+ and FastAPI backend, React 19 frontend, it supports MCP for model context interaction. Key features include Swarm cluster fault tolerance recovery, shadow account simulation, Rich interactive CLI, and automated operations. It provides API and MCP services, enabling real-time task coordination and state management for quantitative trading with out-of-the-box AI solutions.

repos.description: Turn any technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill — ready to study, reference, and use while you work.
repos.summary_zh: 该工具将技术书籍PDF等文档转化为Claude Code技能。通过生成SKILL.md、章节文件、术语表、模式和速查表，实现无幻觉的精准引用与学习。按需加载章节优化资源。应用场景包括技术学习、工作参考和知识管理。技术亮点是多格式支持和结构化知识集成到AI工作流。
repos.summary_en: book-to-skill transforms technical books and documents such as PDFs and EPUBs into structured Claude Code skills. It creates a SKILL.md with core mental models and chapter index, plus on-demand chapter files, glossary, patterns, and cheatsheet. This setup allows accurate, hallucination-free referencing and studying directly in Claude workflows. Ideal for technical professionals who want to retain and apply book knowledge on the job without searching PDFs or relying on potentially inaccurate AI responses. Key advantages include support for various formats, efficient token management via lazy loading, and seamless integration as a custom skill.

repos.description: Your Personal AI Assistant; easy to install, deploy on your own machine or on the cloud; supports multiple chat apps with easily extensible capabilities.
repos.summary_zh: QwenPaw是自主可控的个人AI助手，支持本地或云端部署确保数据隐私。提供日程管理、PDF/Office文档处理、新闻摘要等内置技能，支持自定义扩展。具备多智能体协作能力，可创建独立代理处理不同任务。跨平台连接多种聊天应用，技能决定功能边界，无供应商锁定风险。
repos.summary_en: QwenPaw is a personal AI assistant under your control, deployable locally or in the cloud to ensure data privacy. It features built-in skills including scheduling, PDF/Office document processing, and news digests, with support for custom extensions. Enables multi-agent collaboration by creating independent agents for different tasks. Connects across multiple chat platforms with extensible capabilities and no vendor lock-in.

repos.description: Open-source LLM knowledge platform: turn raw documents into a queryable RAG, an autonomous reasoning agent, and a self-maintaining Wiki.
repos.summary_zh: 腾讯开源的WeKnora是LLM驱动的文档智能框架，基于RAG范式实现深度文档理解与语义检索。采用模块化架构，支持多模态预处理、父-子分块、智能检索与重排序，可处理复杂异构文档。集成Milvus向量数据库，提供上下文感知的高质量问答，适用于企业知识库、智能客服等场景。
repos.summary_en: WeKnora, Tencent's open-source LLM-powered framework, enables deep document understanding and semantic retrieval via RAG paradigm. Its modular architecture supports multimodal preprocessing, hierarchical parent-child chunking, intelligent retrieval, and reranking for complex heterogeneous documents. Integrated with Milvus vector database, it delivers context-aware answers for enterprise knowledge bases and intelligent customer service.

repos.description: The headless browser for AI agents and web scraping
repos.summary_zh: Obscura是用Rust编写的轻量级无头浏览器，专为AI智能体和网页爬虫设计。它内置V8引擎执行真实JavaScript，支持Chrome DevTools Protocol，完全兼容Puppeteer/Playwright API。相比Chrome，内存占用仅30MB（降低85%），启动瞬时，内置反检测功能，是自动化任务的理想选择。
repos.summary_en: Obscura is a lightweight headless browser engine written in Rust, purpose-built for AI agents and large-scale web scraping applications. It executes real JavaScript through the V8 engine, fully supports Chrome DevTools Protocol, and serves as a drop-in replacement for both Puppeteer and Playwright. Compared to traditional headless Chrome, Obscura reduces memory usage by 85% to just 30MB, achieves instant startup, and features built-in anti-detection mechanisms. This combination of performance, compatibility, and stealth makes it ideal for scalable browser automation tasks.

repos.description: Prompt as Code | GPT Image 2 / 2.5 提示词与案例库，530+ 个案例、20+ 套工业级模板与可复用 Skills，新增 2.5 同提示词对比专区，附完整提示词与生成记录，持续更新。
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库是GPT-Image2的Prompt as Code工业级提示词引擎与模板库，逆向工程506+案例，涵盖UI、Poster、产品等13类场景，提炼20+工业模板与Agent Skills。配套网站支持提示浏览、复制、筛选与测试生成，助力专业AI图像生成与自动化工作流，持续更新。
repos.summary_en: The awesome-gpt-image-2 repository provides an industrial-grade Prompt as Code engine and template library for GPT-Image2. It features over 506 reverse-engineered cases across 13 categories including UI, posters, products, and photography, plus 20+ industrial templates and Agent Skills. A companion website enables browsing, copying prompts, filtering by style or scene, and testing generations. Designed for professional AI image generation, automation workflows, and agent integration with ongoing updates.

repos.description: 📚 从零开始构建大模型
repos.summary_zh: Datawhale推出的Happy-LLM是系统性大语言模型学习教程，从NLP基础到Transformer架构层层深入，手把手教你实现LLaMA2模型并完成预训练、微调全流程。项目结合理论与实践，覆盖RAG、Agent等前沿应用，为零基础学习者提供从原理理解到动手实战的完整路径，真正掌握大模型开发核心技能。
repos.summary_en: Happy-LLM by Datawhale is a comprehensive tutorial that demystifies large language models from the ground up. Starting with NLP fundamentals and Transformer architecture, it provides hands-on guidance to implement LLaMA2 and execute the complete training workflow—from pre-training to fine-tuning with LoRA/QLoRA. The project bridges theory and practice, covering cutting-edge applications including RAG and Agent development, equipping learners with essential skills to build and deploy LLMs independently.

repos.description: Free, local plugin that keeps tool output out of your coding agent's context window. Sandbox and SQLite FTS5 search, 99% fewer bytes in context. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Pi, OMP, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI and 4 more agents. Zero telemetry.
repos.summary_zh: Context Mode 是面向 AI 编码代理的上下文优化工具。作为 MCP 服务器，它通过沙箱工具输出实现 98% 上下文减少，支持 15 个平台集成。利用 SQLite 追踪会话并以 FTS5/BM25 检索关键信息，倡导代码执行范式处理数据。集成 Claude、Cursor 等 IDE，已获微软、谷歌团队采用。
repos.summary_en: Context Mode optimizes context windows for AI coding agents as an MCP server. It sandboxes tool outputs for 98% reduction, e.g., 315KB to 5.4KB. SQLite with FTS5 and BM25 ensures session continuity by indexing and retrieving relevant events on compaction. 'Think in code' via ctx_* tools lets agents script data processing instead of loading raw data. Supports 15 platforms like Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code Copilot via plugins and hooks. Adopted by Microsoft, Google, Meta teams.

repos.description: Stealth Chromium that passes every bot detection test. Drop-in Playwright replacement with source-level fingerprint patches. 50+ tests passed.
repos.summary_zh: CloakBrowser 是一款源码级深度改造的隐身 Chromium 浏览器，通过 58 个 C++ 补丁从底层消除自动化指纹，完美绕过 Cloudflare Turnstile、reCAPTCHA v3 等 30+ 机器人检测系统。无缝兼容 Playwright/Puppeteer API，一行代码替换，内置类人行为模拟，为网页爬虫、数据采集和自动化测试提供终极反检测解决方案。
repos.summary_en: CloakBrowser is a stealth Chromium browser with 58 source-level C++ patches that fundamentally eliminate automation fingerprints. It achieves a 0.9 reCAPTCHA v3 score and passes 30+ bot detection tests including Cloudflare Turnstile and FingerprintJS. Offering seamless Playwright/Puppeteer API compatibility with one-line code replacement, built-in human-like behavior simulation, and automatic binary updates, it delivers the ultimate anti-detection solution for web scraping, data collection, and automation tasks.

repos.description: An LLM-powered knowledge curation system that researches a topic and generates a full-length report with citations.
repos.summary_zh: STORM是斯坦福开发的LLM驱动知识整理系统，通过两阶段流程自动生成带引用的维基百科式长文。其核心技术是多视角提问机制，引导LLM提出深度研究问题，结合互联网检索与向量搜索构建知识大纲，再生成完整报告。Co-STORM扩展支持人机协作，已服务超7万用户，支持GPT-4o等模型及Bing/You.com检索，提供Python包与Streamlit界面。
repos.summary_en: STORM is a Stanford-developed LLM-powered knowledge curation system that automatically generates full-length, cited Wikipedia-style articles through a two-stage pipeline. Its core innovation is perspective-guided question asking that enables deep research, combined with internet retrieval and vector search to build topic outlines before article generation. The enhanced Co-STORM supports human-AI collaboration. Serving over 70,000 users, it integrates GPT-4o, Bing/You.com search, and offers a Python package with Streamlit UI for research assistance and knowledge exploration.

repos.description: Memory and context engine + app that is extremely fast, scalable, and can be run fully locally. The Memory API for the AI era.
repos.summary_zh: supermemory 是一个高性能、可扩展的AI记忆引擎，定位为用户的'第二大脑'。核心亮点在于支持MCP协议，可无缝集成Claude、Cursor等AI工具，实现智能记忆检索与对话。支持URL、PDF、文本等多格式内容导入，提供浏览器插件和Raycast扩展。采用API优先设计，既可作为个人知识管理平台，也能通过开发者控制台集成到企业工作流，支持自托管部署。
repos.summary_en: Supermemory is a high-performance, scalable AI memory engine positioned as your 'second brain.' Its core strength lies in MCP protocol integration, enabling seamless connectivity with AI tools like Claude and Cursor for intelligent memory retrieval and chat. It supports multi-format content import (URLs, PDFs, text) via browser extensions and Raycast. API-first design allows both personal knowledge management and enterprise workflow integration through its developer console, with self-hosting options available.

repos.description: Edit videos with coding agents
repos.summary_zh: video-use 是开源视频编辑技能，让编码智能体（Claude Code等）通过自然语言完成剪辑。用户投放原始素材后对话即可输出final.mp4，自动去除语气词与静音、色彩分级、字幕烧录、动画叠加与自我评估。核心以ElevenLabs词级转录+按需视觉合成驱动LLM精准决策，结合ffmpeg渲染，支持会话记忆，无需传统时间线工具。
repos.summary_en: video-use is an open-source skill that lets coding agents (Claude Code etc.) edit videos via natural language. Drop raw footage, chat, and get final.mp4: auto-cuts fillers/dead space, color grades, burns subtitles, generates overlays, and self-evaluates. LLM reasons from ElevenLabs word-level transcripts plus on-demand visual composites, rendered via ffmpeg, with session memory—no timelines or menus needed.

repos.description: An open source design system that's fully customizable and agent ready
repos.summary_zh: Astryx 是 Meta 开源的设计系统，基于 React 19 与 StyleX，提供 150+ 无障碍组件、主题定制、暗黑模式及 CLI 工具。其开放内部结构支持任意层级组合与源码抽取，样式无锁定，可无缝对接 Tailwind 等方案，并专为人类开发者与 AI 智能体协同构建而优化。
repos.summary_en: Astryx is an open-source design system from Meta, built on React 19 and StyleX, offering 150+ accessible components, theming, dark mode, and a CLI. Its open internals allow composition at any level and source ejection, with no styling lock-in, enabling seamless integration with Tailwind and other CSS approaches, designed for both human developers and AI agents.

repos.description: Make Any Website into CLI & Use your logged-in browser by AI agent.
repos.summary_zh: OpenCLI 是一款将任意网站转换为命令行接口的自动化工具，核心在于让 AI 智能体通过已登录的浏览器操作网页（导航、填表、点击、数据提取）。内置 Bilibili、知乎等适配器，通过浏览器扩展与本地守护进程实现安全交互，支持自定义命令扩展，并集成本地工具与 Electron 应用，实现高效自动化与 AI 驱动交互。
repos.summary_en: OpenCLI is an automation tool that converts any website into a command-line interface (CLI), enabling AI agents to operate websites via a logged-in browser for navigation, form filling, clicking, and data extraction. It provides built-in adapters for platforms like Bilibili and Zhihu, a browser extension with a local daemon, and allows custom command extensions. It also integrates local tools and Electron apps, serving as a versatile hub for human and AI-driven automation workflows.

repos.description: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI Agents — turning conversations, docs, and code into four reusable memory assets (Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki, Code-Graph) that are governed, shared, and equipped across agents and frameworks.
repos.summary_zh: TencentDB Agent Memory 为 AI Agent 提供完全本地的长期记忆解决方案，采用 4 层渐进式管道（L0 Conversation→L1 Atom→L2 Scenario→L3 Persona）实现符号化短期记忆与分层长期记忆。拒绝平铺向量存储，通过 Mermaid 符号图与异构存储（DB+Markdown）实现渐进披露与全 traceable 召回。集成 OpenClaw/Hermes 后，Token 消耗最高降 61.38%，任务通过率相对提升 51.52%，PersonaMem 准确率从 48% 升至 76%。适用于长程 Agent 任务与个性化体验，零外部 API 依赖。
repos.summary_en: TencentDB Agent Memory delivers fully local long-term memory for AI Agents via a 4-tier progressive pipeline (L0 Conversation → L1 Atom → L2 Scenario → L3 Persona), combining symbolic short-term memory with layered long-term memory. It rejects flat vector storage, using Mermaid symbol graphs and heterogeneous storage (DB + Markdown) for progressive disclosure and full traceability. When integrated with OpenClaw/Hermes, it cuts token usage by up to 61.38%, boosts task success by up to 51.52% relatively, and raises PersonaMem accuracy from 48% to 76%. Ideal for long-horizon agent tasks and personalization, with zero external API dependencies.

repos.description: AI-agent Skill for generating polished HTML slide decks: editorial magazine and Swiss layouts, image prompts, social covers, and a WebGL/low-power presentation runtime.
repos.summary_zh: 为AI Agent提供高质量HTML PPT生成能力，内置电子杂志与瑞士国际主义双视觉系统，支持单文件横向翻页演示、多平台封面生成及Codex配图流程。解决AI生成PPT的视觉质量控制难题，适用于个人风格演讲、产品发布及方法论展示，输出无需构建、可直接打开的HTML文件。
repos.summary_en: An AI Agent skill for generating polished HTML slide decks with dual visual systems: editorial magazine and Swiss internationalist styles. Enables single-file horizontal presentations, multi-platform social covers, and Codex-integrated image generation. Solves visual quality control for AI-generated slides, ideal for personal talks, product launches, and methodology showcases with zero-build delivery.

repos.description: Huashu Design 3.0 · 在 agent 里打一句话，拿回能交付的设计：网页 / App 原型 / 可编辑 PPTX / 动画 / 信息图 · 六个候选挑三个方向 · 84 种带样张的风格库 · 越用越懂你的外观账本与设计体检 · HTML-native design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor & any agent
repos.summary_zh: 华数设计是一款HTML原生的AI设计技能，可将文本描述直接转化为可交付的生产级设计稿。支持Claude Code等主流AI编程助手，3-30分钟内生成可点击的App原型、演讲幻灯片、60秒动画及信息图。核心亮点包括：20种内置设计哲学与5维评审体系确保专业品质；Motion Design引擎支持时间轴动画与MP4/GIF导出；HTML幻灯片可转为可编辑PPTX；Tweaks面板实现参数化实时调整。无需Figma插件，纯文本交互，输出印刷级排版与跨平台HTML文件。
repos.summary_en: Huashu Design is an HTML-native AI design skill that transforms text prompts into production-ready deliverables within 3-30 minutes. Compatible with Claude Code and other AI agents, it generates clickable App prototypes, presentation slides, motion graphics, and infographics. Key features include: 20 built-in design philosophies with 5-dimension expert review system; Motion Design engine supporting timeline animation and MP4/GIF export; HTML slides convertible to editable PPTX; Tweaks panel for parametric adjustments. No Figma plugins needed—pure text interface delivers print-quality layouts and cross-platform HTML output.

repos.description: JavaScript in-page GUI agent. Control web interfaces with natural language.
repos.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴Page Agent是一个创新的页内JavaScript GUI代理框架，通过自然语言直接控制Web界面。其核心亮点在于纯前端实现，无需浏览器扩展或后端服务，基于文本化DOM操作避免截图和OCR依赖。支持接入任意LLM，提供人机协同UI，适用于SaaS智能助手、ERP/CRM表单自动填充、无障碍访问及多页面自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: Alibaba Page Agent is an innovative in-page JavaScript GUI agent framework that controls web interfaces via natural language. Its key advantages include pure frontend implementation without browser extensions or backend services, direct DOM manipulation avoiding screenshots and OCR. It supports integration with any LLM, offers human-in-the-loop UI, and is ideal for SaaS AI copilots, smart form filling in ERP/CRM systems, accessibility enhancements, and cross-page automation.

repos.description: A format specification for describing a visual identity to coding agents. DESIGN.md gives agents a persistent, structured understanding of a design system.
repos.summary_zh: DESIGN.md 是 Google Labs 开源的视觉身份描述格式规范，专为编码代理设计。通过 YAML 前置元数据定义设计令牌（颜色、排版、间距等），结合 Markdown 散文阐述设计理念，提供持久结构化的设计系统理解。核心价值确保 AI 生成 UI 的一致性与准确性。适用于 AI 辅助前端开发、设计系统跨工具迁移场景。技术亮点融合机器可读令牌与人类可读说明，支持 lint 校验 WCAG 对比、版本 diff 等工具。
repos.summary_en: DESIGN.md is a Google Labs open-sourced format specification for describing visual identities to coding agents. It combines YAML front matter for machine-readable design tokens (colors, typography, spacing) with Markdown prose explaining the rationale. This provides agents with a persistent, structured understanding of design systems for consistent UI generation. Ideal for AI-assisted frontend development and design system portability. Key highlights include WCAG contrast linting, version diffing, token references, and the hybrid machine-human readable format.

repos.description: Open source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs
repos.summary_zh: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源平价替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、反向链接、站点审计及 AI 可见性等核心 SEO 工作流。通过 MCP 服务器和可复用技能实现与 Claude 等 AI 智能体的深度集成，支持 Docker 或 Cloudflare 自托管，用户自带 DataForSEO API 密钥实现按需付费。界面简洁现代，聚焦高效工作流，适合个人、团队及 AI 驱动的 SEO 策略定制与控制。
repos.summary_en: OpenSEO is an open-source, pay-as-you-go alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, delivering essential SEO workflows including keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlinks, site audits, and AI visibility. It features deep AI agent integration via MCP server and customizable skills for tools like Claude, with self-hosting options (Docker or Cloudflare) and BYO DataForSEO API key for usage-based costs. The modern, focused UI empowers individuals, teams, and AI-powered SEO strategies with full control and customization.

repos.description: PM Skills Marketplace: 100+ agentic skills, commands, and plugins — from discovery to strategy, execution, launch, and growth.
repos.summary_zh: PM Skills Marketplace是产品管理AI技能市场，提供68个PM技能和42个链式工作流，覆盖9个插件。它将Teresa Torres、Marty Cagan等专家框架编码为结构化流程，支持Claude等AI助手的发现、策略、执行到增长全生命周期。通过/discover等命令链式调用技能，实现假设映射、PRD撰写等严谨任务，提升产品决策质量，而非仅生成文本。兼容多AI工具，安装便捷。
repos.summary_en: PM Skills Marketplace delivers 68 PM skills and 42 chained workflows across 9 plugins for AI assistants like Claude. It encodes proven frameworks from experts such as Teresa Torres and Marty Cagan into structured processes covering discovery, strategy, execution, launch, and growth. Commands like /discover chain skills for assumption mapping, PRD writing, and metrics definition. Designed for Claude Code and Cowork with broad compatibility, it provides rigorous, decision-focused workflows instead of generic text, enhancing product outcomes through embedded PM expertise.

repos.description: Symphony turns project work into isolated, autonomous implementation runs, allowing teams to manage work instead of supervising coding agents.
repos.summary_zh: Symphony 是 OpenAI 推出的 AI 编程自动化框架，将项目任务转化为独立自主的实现运行。系统监控项目管理工具（如 Linear），自动调度 AI 代理完成编码、测试、代码审查和 PR 合并，并提供 CI 状态、复杂度分析和操作视频作为工作证明。核心价值在于让工程师从监督编码代理中解放，转向高层次工作管理，适用于采用 harness engineering 的工程团队。
repos.summary_en: Symphony is an AI-powered automation framework from OpenAI that transforms project work into isolated, autonomous implementation runs. The system monitors project management tools like Linear, automatically spawning AI agents to handle coding, testing, code review, and PR merging. It provides proof of work including CI status, complexity analysis, and walkthrough videos. The core value proposition enables engineers to manage work at a higher level rather than supervising coding agents directly, targeting teams that have adopted harness engineering practices. This engineering preview is designed for testing in trusted environments.

repos.description: A privacy-first app that strips AI watermarks from content you own.
repos.summary_zh: 隐私优先的开源工具，作为Agent技能与纯标准库Python HTTP服务，精准剥离多厂商AI溯源水印（Unicode隐形字符、统计token标记、C2PA/EXIF等元数据）。支持文本、图像、文档、音视频等格式，专为用户自有内容的隐私卫生设计，兼容Claude/Gemini/OpenAI及开源LLM，零依赖核心运行。
repos.summary_en: Privacy-first open-source tool combining an agent skill with a pure-stdlib Python HTTP service to strip multi-vendor AI provenance watermarks from text and files you own. Handles invisible Unicode, statistical token marks, and C2PA/EXIF/XMP metadata across images, docs, audio/video. Supports Claude, Gemini, OpenAI and open LLMs with zero-dependency core.

repos.description: What are the principles we can use to build LLM-powered software that is actually good enough to put in the hands of production customers?
repos.summary_zh: 12-Factor Agents 提出构建生产级LLM应用的12项核心原则，受经典12要素应用启发。针对当前AI智能体框架在生产环境中的不足，强调将软件工程最佳实践应用于LLM开发，而非简单提示词+工具循环。核心亮点包括上下文工程自主权、小型专注智能体设计，为开发可靠、可维护的面向客户AI应用提供系统性指导。
repos.summary_en: 12-Factor Agents introduces 12 core principles for building production-ready LLM applications, inspired by the classic 12-factor app methodology. Addressing gaps in existing AI agent frameworks, it emphasizes applying software engineering best practices to LLM development rather than simplistic prompt-tool loops. Key highlights include owning your context window and designing small, focused agents. This guide provides systematic guidance for developing reliable, maintainable customer-facing AI applications that go beyond experimental prototypes to deliver real production value.

repos.description: Open-source 3D architecture software for AECO, scan-to-BIM. Agent-friendly, browser-first, MCP, CLI.
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Web 的 3D 建筑编辑器，提供浏览器内专业级 BIM 编辑能力。采用 React Three Fiber + WebGPU 实现高性能渲染，Turborepo  monorepo 架构分离核心逻辑与渲染层，Zustand 分层状态管理配合 IndexedDB 持久化与 Zundo 撤销重做，支持建筑模型的节点化数据管理与实时空间查询。
repos.summary_en: A web-based 3D building editor delivering professional BIM capabilities in-browser. Built on React Three Fiber + WebGPU for high-performance rendering, Turborepo monorepo architecture separates core logic from rendering, with layered Zustand state management, IndexedDB persistence, and Zundo undo/redo. Enables node-based building data management and real-time spatial queries.

repos.description: Roo Code gives you a whole dev team of AI agents in your code editor.
repos.summary_zh: RooCode是VS Code扩展，提供多模式AI开发团队。支持代码生成、架构设计、调试、文档编写等全流程任务，集成MCP服务器实现工具扩展，通过自然语言指令驱动AI代理完成编程工作。
repos.summary_en: RooCode is a VS Code extension that embeds a complete AI-powered development team directly in your code editor. It provides specialized modes including Code for everyday tasks, Architect for system design, Ask for explanations, Debug for issue tracing, and customizable modes for team workflows. The extension integrates with MCP servers for extensible tooling and enables natural language-driven code generation, refactoring, debugging, documentation writing, and task automation.

repos.description: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices
repos.summary_zh: Modern Web Guidance 是 Google Chrome 团队支持的 AI 编码代理技能，提供 SKILL.md 文件与 CLI 工具，将现代 Web 平台专家知识、最佳实践和 API 模式直接注入 AI 代理上下文。帮助代理采用高性能、可访问、安全的原生 API 替代过时方案，覆盖 102 项现代特性及 128 个真实用例，支持 Cursor、Claude 等工具集成，提升 Web 应用开发质量与效率。
repos.summary_en: Modern Web Guidance, supported by the Google Chrome team, is an agent skill (SKILL.md) with a CLI that injects web platform expertise, best practices, and modern API patterns into AI coding agents. It guides agents to use high-performance, accessible, and secure native APIs instead of legacy patterns, covering 102 modern features and 128 real-world use cases across UX, CSS, performance, accessibility, and built-in AI. It integrates with tools like Cursor, Claude, and Gemini for better web development.

repos.description: AI video skill for Claude Code & Codex — cinematic, editable product promos with Remotion: 124 shot recipe cards, 150 motion previews, beat sync, sound design, Motion Workbench & JianYing (CapCut CN) export.

repos.summary_en: Generation failed

repos.description: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop application that turns your documents into an organized, interlinked knowledge base — automatically. Instead of traditional RAG (retrieve-and-answer from scratch every time), the LLM incrementally builds and maintains a persistent wiki from your sources。
repos.summary_zh: LLM Wiki 是一款跨平台桌面应用，采用增量编译模式构建自组织知识库，颠覆传统RAG每次查询重检索的机制。核心亮点包括：双阶段思维链文档摄入、多模态图像理解、四信号知识图谱、Louvain社区发现，以及本地API支持AI智能体调用。实现文档自动结构化为可追溯、可探索的互联知识网络。
repos.summary_en: LLM Wiki is a cross-platform desktop app that incrementally builds a persistent, self-organizing knowledge base from documents—compiling knowledge once instead of re-deriving on every query like traditional RAG. Key features include two-step Chain-of-Thought ingestion, multimodal image understanding, 4-signal knowledge graph, Louvain community detection, and local API for AI agent integration. Automatically transforms documents into interconnected, explorable knowledge networks with source traceability.

repos.description: Rebuild the object in a reference image as a code-only, procedural, quality-gated, animation-ready Three.js model. Token-efficient image-to-3D.
repos.summary_zh: img2threejs 是一个面向 AI 编码代理（如 Claude）的开源技能，可将单张参考图像重建为代码生成的程序化 Three.js 3D 模型。它采用多阶段雕刻管道、严格质量门控、细节清单和代理视觉审查，确保比例、材质、细节高保真；Python 脚本处理验证与状态管理，实现令牌高效，输出为动画就绪的 TypeScript 代码（含枢轴、插槽），支持硬表面对象与角色。适用于网页 3D 应用、游戏道具与交互体验，重建方式为代码而非网格或摄影测量。
repos.summary_en: img2threejs is an open-source skill for AI coding agents (e.g., Claude) that reconstructs a single reference image into a code-only, procedural Three.js 3D model. It uses a multi-stage sculpting pipeline with strict quality gates, detail inventory, and agent-vision reviews for high-fidelity proportions, materials, and details. Python stdlib scripts handle validation and state for token efficiency, with the LLM focused on judgment. Outputs are animation-ready TypeScript factories from primitives and shaders, supporting hard-surface objects and characters. Ideal for web 3D apps, game props, and interactive experiences via code reconstruction rather than meshes.

repos.description: ⛰️ LifeOS — The AI-powered Life Operating System that helps you hill climb to wherever you're going.
repos.summary_zh: danielmiessler/LifeOS（Personal_AI_Infrastructure/PAI）是开源Agentic AI基础设施，定位为Life Operating System。它以Claude为核心构建个性化数字助手，深度捕获用户Telos、目标、知识与偏好；采用文本/Markdown文件系统作为上下文（无RAG）、自定义七阶段Algorithm驱动当前到理想状态转变，并集成Pulse仪表盘、技能系统与自改进循环。基于TypeScript与Bun构建，强调人类优先与上下文支架，适用于个人生产力、目标管理与全生命周期优化。
repos.summary_en: danielmiessler/LifeOS (Personal_AI_Infrastructure/PAI) is an open-source agentic AI infrastructure functioning as a Life Operating System. It builds a personalized Digital Assistant powered by Claude that deeply captures user Telos, goals, knowledge, and preferences. Key features include text/Markdown filesystem as context (no RAG), a custom 7-phase Algorithm for current-to-ideal state progression, Pulse dashboard, skills system, and self-improvement loops. Built with TypeScript and Bun on Claude Code, it prioritizes humans and context scaffolding for personal productivity, goal achievement, and holistic life optimization.

repos.description: Let Claude Code, Codex or Cursor use your real Chrome, logged in as you. One prompt to set up. Open source, MIT.
repos.summary_zh: Browser Harness 是一个自愈式浏览器控制框架，通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 直连真实浏览器，让 LLM 自主完成任意网页任务。其核心创新在于动态生成缺失的辅助代码并持续学习优化，每次运行都自我改进。提供可复用的领域技能系统，支持从 LinkedIn 营销到电商下单等复杂自动化场景，架构精简仅千行代码。
repos.summary_en: Browser Harness is a self-healing browser automation framework that connects LLMs directly to real browsers via Chrome DevTools Protocol. Its core innovation lies in dynamically generating missing helper code during execution and continuously learning from each run. The framework features a reusable domain skills system for complex tasks like LinkedIn outreach and e-commerce ordering. With a minimal architecture of ~1k lines, it enables autonomous web task completion without predefined scripts, representing a new paradigm in LLM-driven browser automation.

repos.description: SkillOpt is a text-space optimizer that trains reusable natural-language skills for frozen LLM agents through trajectory-driven edits, validation-gated updates, and deployable best_skill.md artifacts.
repos.summary_zh: SkillOpt是微软的文本空间优化器，为冻结LLM代理训练可复用自然语言技能。通过轨迹驱动编辑、验证门控更新，模拟神经网络训练（epochs、mini-batch、学习率），不修改模型权重，输出best_skill.md。支持SearchQA、ALFWorld等多基准，适用于自进化代理技能场景。技术亮点包括轨迹分析、迭代优化与可复用部署。
repos.summary_en: SkillOpt is a Microsoft text-space optimizer that trains reusable natural-language skills for frozen LLM agents. It uses trajectory-driven edits, reflection, bounded updates, and held-out validation gates, mirroring neural network training with epochs, minibatches, learning rates, and gates—but entirely in text space without weight changes. It produces deployable best_skill.md artifacts and shows strong gains across benchmarks like SearchQA, ALFWorld, DocVQA, and others. Ideal for self-evolving, transferable agent skills in QA, tool-use, math, and embodied tasks.

repos.description: The absolute trainer to light up AI agents.
repos.summary_zh: Agent Lightning是微软开源的AI智能体训练框架，核心卖点是几乎无需代码变更即可优化任意智能体。它支持LangChain、AutoGen、CrewAI等主流框架，甚至纯Python OpenAI代码。框架采用强化学习、自动提示优化等算法，可针对性地优化多智能体系统中的单个或多个智能体，显著提升智能体性能。
repos.summary_en: Agent Lightning is Microsoft's open-source AI agent training framework that optimizes agents with minimal code changes. It supports any agent framework including LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, or even raw Python OpenAI code. The framework employs reinforcement learning, automatic prompt optimization, and supervised fine-tuning to selectively enhance individual or multiple agents within multi-agent systems. Its key innovation lies in framework-agnostic compatibility and zero-code optimization, enabling developers to rapidly improve agent performance without rebuilding existing implementations.

repos.description: Turn any website into a structured API. Extract, automate, search and monitor the web.
repos.summary_zh: Maxun 是一款开源无代码网页数据平台，可将任意网站转化为结构化 API。它提供四大机器人类型：Extract（支持录制和 AI 自然语言提取）、Scrape（整页转 Markdown/HTML）、Crawl（全站爬取）和 Search（自动化搜索）。平台通过模拟真实用户行为，实现从简单到复杂的自动化数据采集，适用于 AI 工作流、竞品监控和商业智能等场景。
repos.summary_en: Maxun is an open-source no-code web data platform that transforms any website into structured APIs. It offers four robot types: Extract (with Recorder and AI natural language modes), Scrape (full-page to Markdown/HTML), Crawl (entire site crawling), and Search (automated web searches). By emulating real user behavior, it enables automated data collection workflows for AI pipelines, competitive intelligence, and business analytics.

repos.description: Get started with building Fullstack Agents using Gemini 2.5 and LangGraph
repos.summary_zh: 基于Gemini 2.5和LangGraph的全栈研究型智能体快速启动模板。前端采用React，后端使用LangGraph构建具备反思能力的AI代理，可动态生成搜索词、执行网页检索、识别知识缺口并迭代优化，最终生成带引用的权威答案。提供完整的开发热重载流程，是构建生产级研究增强对话AI的典范参考架构。
repos.summary_en: Fullstack research agent quickstart template integrating React frontend with LangGraph backend, powered by Gemini 2.5. The agent implements reflective reasoning to dynamically generate search queries, perform web research via Google Search API, identify knowledge gaps, and iteratively refine its approach until producing comprehensive, cited answers. Includes hot-reloading development workflow and CLI example, serving as a production-ready reference for building sophisticated research-augmented conversational AI systems.

repos.description: A lightweight, lightning-fast, in-process vector database
repos.summary_zh: Zvec 是阿里巴巴开源的轻量级进程内向量数据库，基于内部验证的 Proxima 搜索引擎构建。它提供毫秒级十亿向量相似性检索，支持密集/稀疏向量与混合查询，无需独立服务即可直接嵌入应用。适用于推荐系统、语义搜索等场景，具备生产级性能、低延迟与极简部署的核心优势。
repos.summary_en: Zvec is a lightweight, open-source in-process vector database developed by Alibaba, powered by the battle-tested Proxima search engine. It provides millisecond-level similarity search for billions of vectors, natively supporting dense and sparse embeddings with hybrid search combining semantic and structured filters. As an embeddable library, it requires no standalone server and runs directly within applications. Ideal for recommendation systems, semantic search, and edge AI scenarios, Zvec delivers production-grade performance, low latency, and effortless deployment across platforms from cloud servers to edge devices.

repos.description: Plan, run and supervise fleets of agents from task to merged PR. Desktop (macOS, Windows, Linux) + iPhone & Android apps.  Supports Claude Code, Codex & 35+ coding agents.
repos.summary_zh: Agent Orchestrator 是一款跨平台桌面应用，用于统一编排和监督多个编码 AI 智能体（支持 Claude Code、Codex 等 25+ 工具）。每个任务独立分配智能体、隔离工作区和 Git 分支，通过实时看板追踪 PR、CI 和评审全流程，实现从规划到合并的自动化协作开发。
repos.summary_en: Agent Orchestrator is a cross-platform desktop workspace for orchestrating and supervising teams of coding AI agents from planning to merge. It supports 25+ agent harnesses including Claude Code and Codex. Each task gets its own agent, isolated workspace, and dedicated Git branch. A live Kanban board tracks workers, pull requests, CI runs, and code reviews in real time. A local daemon monitors agent activity and source-control state, providing a unified project view instead of disconnected terminals and branches. It enables efficient parallel development across multiple coding agents.

repos.description: 首家工业级全流程 AI 影视生产平台。Industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film & video production. From shorts to live-action with Hollywood-standard workflows.
repos.summary_zh: waoowaoo是首家工业级全流程AI影视生产平台，通过AI Agent实现小说到视频的全自动改编。支持剧本分析、角色场景生成、分镜制作、AI配音等好莱坞标准工作流，基于Next.js全栈框架与Docker容器化部署，为短剧和漫画视频创作提供可控、高效的生产解决方案。
repos.summary_en: waoowaoo is the industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film and video production. It automates the entire workflow from novel text to finished videos, featuring AI script analysis, character/scene generation, storyboard production, and multi-voice synthesis following Hollywood-standard pipelines. Built on Next.js 15 full-stack framework with Docker containerization, MySQL database, and Redis queue system, it delivers an industrial-grade solution for short drama and manga video creation, enabling scalable, efficient, and consistent content generation for professional creators.

repos.description: Fully autonomous & self-evolving research from idea to paper. Chat an Idea. Get a Paper. 🦞
repos.summary_zh: AutoResearchClaw 是一个全自动化学术研究流水线，可将单一研究想法转化为会议级论文。系统采用23阶段流程，集成 arXiv 和 Semantic Scholar 真实文献检索、硬件感知的代码实验（GPU/MPS/CPU 自动检测）、多智能体同行评审（CodeAgent、BenchmarkAgent、FigureAgent）以及 NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR 的 LaTeX 模板生成。通过4层引用验证和AI-slop检测确保学术严谨性，无需人工干预即可完成从构思到论文的全流程。
repos.summary_en: AutoResearchClaw is a fully autonomous 23-stage research pipeline that transforms a single idea into a conference-ready academic paper. It integrates real literature search from arXiv and Semantic Scholar, hardware-aware sandboxed experiments with automatic GPU/MPS/CPU detection, multi-agent peer review (CodeAgent, BenchmarkAgent, FigureAgent), and generates LaTeX papers using NeurIPS/ICML/ICLR templates. The system ensures academic rigor through 4-layer citation integrity verification and AI-slop detection, delivering complete papers with verified BibTeX references without human intervention.

repos.description: Self-evolving agent: grows skill tree from 3.3K-line seed, achieving full system control with 6x less token consumption
repos.summary_zh: GenericAgent是一个极简的自进化智能体框架，仅3K行核心代码，通过9个原子工具实现系统级控制（浏览器、终端、文件系统等）。它自动将任务执行路径固化为技能，形成个人技能树，支持多模型与跨平台，上下文窗口小于30K，显著降低token消耗与幻觉，提升任务成功率。
repos.summary_en: GenericAgent is a minimal self-evolving autonomous agent framework with only ~3K lines of core code. Through 9 atomic tools, it grants LLMs system-level control over browsers, terminals, filesystems, and more. It automatically crystallizes task execution paths into reusable skills, forming a personal skill tree. Supporting multiple models and cross-platform, it uses a <30K context window, reducing token consumption and hallucinations.

repos.description: The open-source Claude Motion & CapCut alternative. Turn a reference video into editable motion graphics with your brand kit. Export MP4s for YouTube, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and TikTok. A full-stack agentic video studio with 300+ Motion.md guides and support for 22 agents, including Claude Code, Codex, DSH, and WorkBuddy.
repos.summary_zh: OpenMotion 是首个全栈智能体视频生成器，支持上传参考视频或粘贴链接，通过 HTML 编码视频，用自有品牌素材重新创作。内置 Motion.md 格式描述镜头顺序与转场，支持 BYOA/BYOK，集成图像、视频、音乐和语音生成。
repos.summary_en: OpenMotion is the first full-stack agentic video generator. Upload a reference video or paste a social link to recreate it with your own brand kit. Code video with HTML, edit timing in Studio, and render MP4. Features Motion.md format for shot order, timing, and transitions. Supports BYOA/BYOK with 22 local agents and built-in models for images, video, music, and voice.

repos.description: The all-in-one, open-source backend platform for agentic coding. InsForge gives your coding agent database, auth, storage, compute, hosting, and AI gateway to ship full-stack apps end-to-end.
repos.summary_zh: InsForge 是专为 AI 编程代理打造的**开源一体化后端平台**，提供数据库、认证、存储、计算、托管及 AI 网关等全栈能力。通过 **MCP Server** 和 **CLI+Skills** 双模式，让 AI 代理能像资深后端工程师一样操作资源，实现应用开发、部署、调试的端到端自动化，极大提升 AI 编程效率与质量。
repos.summary_en: InsForge is an **open-source, all-in-one backend platform** purpose-built for agentic coding. It equips AI coding agents with comprehensive capabilities including database, authentication, storage, compute, hosting, and AI gateway. Through dual interfaces of **MCP Server** (self-hosted/cloud) and **CLI+Skills** (cloud-only), agents can operate backend resources like professional engineers, enabling **end-to-end automation** of full-stack application development, deployment, and debugging, dramatically improving AI coding efficiency and quality.

repos.description: 中文小黑怪诞正文配图生成 Skill | 16:9 白底手绘 | 少量红橙蓝批注 | Codex Skill
