repos.summary_zh: Codex Skill，专为中文文章生成16:9白底手绘怪诞正文配图。以“小黑”IP为核心角色参与动作，提炼认知锚点转化为流程、状态或隐喻图，配少量红橙蓝中文批注，适合知识内容与方法论插图，强调记忆点而非信息图。
repos.summary_en: A Codex Skill that turns Chinese articles into 16:9 white-background hand-drawn surreal illustrations. Centered on the “Xiaohei” character actively performing key actions, it visualizes cognitive anchors as processes, states or metaphors with sparse red-orange-blue annotations, ideal for knowledge and methodology content.

repos.description: Capture first. Organize later. A local-first Markdown app that turns scattered records into clear notes with AI.
repos.summary_zh: NoteGen是一款轻量级(25MB)跨平台Markdown笔记应用，深度融合AI智能能力，原生支持RAG检索增强与MCP协议，能够智能桥接碎片化记录与结构化写作，实现知识高效组织与管理。
repos.summary_en: Lightweight (25MB) cross-platform Markdown note app with AI, RAG and MCP support for intelligent knowledge organization.

repos.description: Pocket Flow: Codebase to Tutorial
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于 Pocket Flow 框架的 AI 代码库分析项目，能自动爬取 GitHub 仓库并构建知识库，通过识别核心抽象和交互关系，将复杂代码转化为适合新手的可视化教程。项目已生成 AutoGen、FastAPI、LangGraph 等热门框架的教程，并在 Hacker News 获得 900+ 赞。提供在线服务 code2tutorial.com，用户只需粘贴 GitHub 链接即可生成教程，极大降低了代码库的学习门槛。
repos.summary_en: This project uses the Pocket Flow LLM framework to automatically crawl GitHub repositories and build knowledge bases. It analyzes entire codebases to identify core abstractions and interactions, transforming complex code into beginner-friendly tutorials with visualizations. The system has generated tutorials for popular frameworks like AutoGen, FastAPI, and LangGraph, reaching Hacker News front page with 900+ upvotes. An online service at code2tutorial.com is now available, allowing users to simply paste a GitHub link to generate tutorials without installation.

repos.description: 👩‍🚒 Good content deserves good paper. Layout rules and templates that let AI agents export PDF, PNG and editable PowerPoint.
repos.summary_zh: Kami是AI文档生成的设计约束系统，解决AI输出布局混乱、设计平庸的核心痛点。内置10种专业模板（财报、简历、PPT、落地页等），通过统一约束语言确保视觉一致性。深度支持中英日CJK语言，专为Claude等AI Agent设计，开箱即用，轻量高效，让AI文档达到可交付品质。
repos.summary_en: Kami is a design constraint system for AI-generated documents, addressing inconsistent layouts and generic designs in AI outputs. It provides 10 professional templates (equity reports, resumes, slides, portfolios, landing pages) with unified constraints for visual consistency. Built for AI agents like Claude Code, it offers first-class English/Chinese support and best-effort Japanese/CJK. The lightweight system integrates seamlessly, enabling agents to produce production-ready, polished documents directly.

repos.description: Self-evolving memory OS for LLM & AI Agents: ultra-persistent memory, hybrid-retrieval, and cross-task skill reuse, with 35.24% token savings and DeepSeek Harness support.
repos.summary_zh: MemOS是面向LLM与AI Agent的自演化记忆操作系统，统一长期记忆的存/取/管，支持多模态、图结构API、MemCube知识库与混合检索。实现跨任务技能复用、异步调度与反馈校正，显著降低Token消耗，兼容DeepSeek Harness等生态，赋能持久上下文与个性化Agent。
repos.summary_en: MemOS is a self-evolving Memory Operating System for LLMs and AI Agents, unifying store/retrieve/manage of long-term memory with multi-modal support, graph-structured API, MemCube knowledge bases and hybrid retrieval. It enables cross-task skill reuse, async scheduling and feedback correction, delivering major token savings and DeepSeek Harness compatibility for persistent, personalized agents.

repos.description: Stealth headless browser for AI agents — bypass Cloudflare, bot detection, and anti-scraping. Drop-in Puppeteer/Playwright replacement.
repos.summary_zh: camofox-browser 是基于 Camoufox（C++ 层修改的 Firefox 内核）构建的反检测浏览器服务，专为 AI 智能体设计。它通过底层指纹欺骗（WebGL、AudioContext、硬件并发数等）绕过 Cloudflare 和反爬机制，提供 REST API 接口。相比 Playwright，内存占用低至 40MB，支持可访问性快照（比 HTML 小 90%）、会话隔离和搜索宏，是 Puppeteer/Playwright 的直接替代方案。
repos.summary_en: camofox-browser is a stealth headless browser service for AI agents, built on Camoufox—a Firefox fork with C++-level fingerprint spoofing. It bypasses Cloudflare, bot detection, and anti-scraping by patching navigator.hardwareConcurrency, WebGL, AudioContext, screen geometry, and WebRTC before JavaScript execution. Offering a REST API with 90% smaller accessibility snapshots than HTML, stable element refs, session isolation, search macros, and ~40MB idle memory, it serves as a drop-in replacement for Playwright/Puppeteer in AI automation and web scraping workflows.

repos.description: Use your most capable model to audit your codebase and write plans for cheaper models to execute.
repos.summary_zh: improve 是一个 AI 代理技能，利用最强模型深度审计任意代码库，生成自包含的 Markdown 实施计划供廉价模型执行。核心价值在于智能分工：高智能模型负责 Recon 映射仓库栈与规范、多类别并行审计、Vet vetting 与优先级排序，执行交由低成本模型。计划含验证门、硬边界、停止条件与漂移检测，支持分支审计、execute 审查、GitHub issues 集成及 reconcile 闭环。适用于代码优化、安全审计、性能提升与功能规划场景，提升多模型代理工作流效率。
repos.summary_en: improve is an agent skill that uses the most capable models to audit any codebase and produce self-contained Markdown implementation plans for cheaper models to execute. Core value lies in intelligent division of labor: powerful models handle recon (mapping stack, conventions, verification commands), parallel multi-category audits (security, perf, tech debt, direction), vetting, and prioritization; execution is offloaded. Plans include verification gates, hard boundaries, STOP conditions, and drift checks. Supports focused/branch audits, isolated worktree execution with review, GitHub issue publishing, and reconciliation. Ideal for efficient codebase maintenance in multi-model AI agent ecosystems.

repos.description: Git. Ship. Done - Core
repos.summary_zh: GSD-Core是轻量级元提示与上下文工程系统，专为Claude Code、Cursor等AI编码工具设计。通过六命令循环（初始化、讨论、规划、并行执行、验证、交付）解决上下文腐烂，实现规范驱动开发。支持跨平台npm安装，生成原子提交与干净Git历史，适用于独立开发者和小团队。已获亚马逊、谷歌等工程师信赖，是AI辅助可靠交付的执行框架。
repos.summary_en: GSD-Core is a lightweight meta-prompting, context engineering, and spec-driven development system for AI coding tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and more. It solves context rot with a six-command loop: initialize or map codebases, discuss phases, plan with verification, execute in parallel sub-agents using fresh contexts, verify, and ship with clean Git history. Ideal for solo builders and small teams. Cross-platform via npm, trusted by engineers at Amazon, Google, Shopify, and Webflow.

repos.description: Open-source intelligence for the global theater. Track everything from the corporate/private jets of the wealthy, and spy satellites, to seismic events in one unified interface. Hook an AI agent up to have it parse through data and find previously unseen correlations. The knowledge is available to all but rarely aggregated in the open, until now.
repos.summary_zh: ShadowBroker是实时多域开源情报平台，聚合60+公开数据源包括航班ADS-B、船舶AIS、卫星遥测及地震信息。基于Next.js与MapLibre GL构建交互式地图，支持35+数据层切换与右键地理情报查询。采用自托管架构确保隐私，面向分析师提供全球威胁监控与研究工作。
repos.summary_en: ShadowBroker is a real-time OSINT platform aggregating 60+ public data sources including aircraft ADS-B, maritime AIS, satellite telemetry and seismic events. Built with Next.js and MapLibre GL, it provides 35+ interactive data layers and geospatial analysis tools. Self-hosted deployment ensures privacy for analysts tracking global threats and conducting open-source intelligence research.

repos.description: Give your agents the power of the Hugging Face ecosystem
repos.summary_zh: Hugging Face Skills是面向AI/ML任务的标准化智能体技能定义，支持数据集创建、模型训练与评估。提供Codex、Claude、Gemini、Cursor等多平台兼容，以自包含文件夹形式打包指令与脚本，实现AI编码助手无缝集成。
repos.summary_en: Hugging Face Skills provides standardized agent skill definitions for AI/ML tasks including dataset creation, model training, and evaluation. It offers multi-platform compatibility with Codex, Claude, Gemini, and Cursor, packaging instructions and scripts in self-contained folders for seamless AI coding agent integration.

repos.description: Skills for Design Engineers
repos.summary_zh: UI Skills 是一个面向设计工程师和 AI 智能体的专业技能集合，收录 132 多个高质量技能，聚焦无障碍审计、动效性能优化、UI 基础清理及生产级前端设计等领域。核心价值在于 npx CLI 路由工具，能智能匹配任务至最合适技能，帮助人类与代理创建优质界面。应用场景覆盖 AI 生成代码优化、WCAG 合规检查、动画流畅性提升及组件开发。技术亮点是模块化专家技能、避免通用 AI 美学及多框架实践集成，实现专业、一致的高品质用户体验。
repos.summary_en: UI Skills is a curated collection of over 132 specialized skills for design engineers and AI agents to create superior interfaces. It covers accessibility audits, motion performance fixes, baseline UI polish, and production-grade frontend design. The core value is its CLI routing tool that intelligently matches tasks to the right skill set. Applications include refining AI-generated UIs, ensuring WCAG compliance, optimizing animations, and building polished components with frameworks like React and shadcn/ui. Key highlights are modular expert-contributed guidelines that avoid generic AI aesthetics and promote high craft quality and consistency.

repos.description: Claude-first paid-media operations skill for Claude Code across 12 ad platforms (Google, Meta, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, Microsoft, Apple, Amazon, Reddit, Pinterest, Snapchat, X): source-grounded audits, deterministic findings and evidence coverage, versioned JSON reports, and capability-gated account changes.
repos.summary_zh: 为Claude Code设计的付费广告审计AI技能，覆盖Google、Meta等8大平台，通过250+检查项在10-15分钟内完成原需4-6小时的人工审计。采用加权评分和并行代理技术，提供优先级行动方案与AI创意生成，支持跨平台部署，适用于PPC代理机构、企业内部营销团队及自由顾问。
repos.summary_en: An AI skill for Claude Code that automates paid advertising audits across 8 platforms including Google and Meta. It performs 250+ checks in 10-15 minutes, replacing 4-6 hours of manual work. Features weighted scoring, parallel agents, prioritized action plans, and AI creative generation. Cross-platform compatible for PPC agencies, in-house marketers, and freelance consultants.

repos.description: A skill that turn any brand into a scrollable 3D world landing page
repos.summary_zh: AI代理技能，能为任何品牌或行业生成滚动驱动的沉浸式3D世界落地页。滚动实现相机连续飞行穿越连贯场景，无剪辑。基于Higgsfield AI生成等距场景与视频，JS引擎驱动，支持移动端。框架无关，适用于品牌营销。
repos.summary_en: An agent skill for Claude Code, Codex and similar tools that generates immersive scroll-scrubbed 3D world landing pages for any brand. Scrolling drives continuous camera flights through connected scenes without cuts. Uses Higgsfield AI for isometric scenes and frame-locked videos, with a vanilla JS scrub engine and mobile portrait support. Framework-agnostic for brand marketing.

repos.description: A library of Agent Skills designed to work with the Stitch MCP server. Each skill follows the Agent Skills open standard, for compatibility with coding agents such as Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Cursor.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个为AI编程代理设计的标准化技能库，通过MCP协议与Stitch设计工具深度集成。提供设计系统文档生成、提示词优化、设计稿转React组件等核心能力，兼容Claude Code、Cursor等主流AI编程工具。采用统一技能结构（SKILL.md + 脚本 + 资源 + 示例），实现从设计到代码的自动化工作流，显著提升AI编程效率与质量。
repos.summary_en: A standardized Agent Skills library for AI coding assistants, deeply integrated with Stitch design tool via MCP protocol. Provides core capabilities including design system documentation generation, prompt enhancement, and design-to-React conversion. Compatible with mainstream AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor. Features unified skill structure (SKILL.md + scripts + resources + examples) to automate design-to-code workflows and boost AI programming efficiency.

repos.description: Agent skill that turns natural language, code, Terraform/K8s, SQL, OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Protobuf and GraphQL sources into editable, tested draw.io architecture diagrams: incremental sync, multi-view projection, drift diff, CI architecture tests, whiteboard derasterize, interactive HTML/PPTX/Mermaid exports.
repos.summary_zh: drawio-skill 是一款 AI 驱动的技能，将自然语言描述转化为专业的 draw.io 图表。它支持 6 种预设类型（ERD、UML、序列、架构、ML/深度学习、流程图）、代码库（Python/JS/Go/Rust）结构可视化、10,000+ 官方形状搜索及 321 个 AI/LLM 品牌 logo。集成视觉自检与最多 5 轮迭代精炼，自动修复布局问题，支持 PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG 导出。与 Claude、Cursor 等多种 AI 代理兼容，适用于软件架构设计、代码可视化及系统文档生成场景。
repos.summary_en: drawio-skill is an AI agent skill that converts natural language into professional draw.io diagrams. It offers 6 presets (ERD, UML, Sequence, Architecture, ML/Deep Learning, Flowchart), codebase visualization for Python/JS/Go/Rust via Graphviz auto-layout, search across 10,000+ official shapes, and 321 AI/LLM logos. Features vision self-check with up to 5 rounds of refinement, auto-fixes layout issues, and exports to PNG/SVG/PDF/JPG. Compatible with Claude Code, Cursor and other agents, ideal for architecture design, code analysis, and LLM app documentation.

repos.description: Agent Reinforcement Trainer: train multi-step agents for real-world tasks using GRPO. Give your agents on-the-job training. Reinforcement learning for Qwen3.6, GPT-OSS, Llama, and more!
repos.summary_zh: ART是基于GRPO算法的强化学习框架，用于训练多步智能体执行现实任务。它支持Qwen3.6、GPT-OSS、Llama等主流大模型，提供无服务器RL服务，可降低40%成本、加速训练并免去基础设施管理。开发者可轻松集成到Python应用，快速迭代智能体，提升可靠性。
repos.summary_en: ART is an open-source reinforcement learning framework that employs Generalized Policy Gradient Optimization (GRPO) to train multi-step agents for real-world tasks. It supports popular large language models including Qwen3.6, GPT-OSS, and Llama. The framework provides a serverless RL backend via W&B Training, which cuts costs by 40%, accelerates training by 28%, and eliminates infrastructure management. With an ergonomic Python API, ART allows developers to quickly iterate on agent development, enhancing reliability through experience-based learning.

repos.description: Agent harness for learning difficult things.
repos.summary_zh: LearnHarness 是一款基于 AI 智能体的个性化学习工具，通过测量用户当前理解、规划依赖路径、逐步教学与练习，构建持久化知识图谱，实现自适应教学。支持多平台桌面应用、文件附件与语音输入，帮助用户深入掌握复杂知识。
repos.summary_en: LearnHarness is an AI-agent-powered learning tool that measures current understanding, plans dependency paths, teaches step-by-step, and builds a persistent knowledge graph for personalized adaptive learning. Available as a cross-platform desktop app with file attachment and dictation support, it helps users master difficult topics.

repos.description: High-performance browser automation bridge and multi-instance orchestrator with advanced stealth injection and real-time dashboard.
repos.summary_zh: PinchTab 是专为 AI 智能体设计的高性能浏览器自动化桥接器。通过 12MB 的 Go 二进制文件提供 HTTP API，支持多实例 Chrome 进程 orchestration 与隐身注入。核心突破在于 token 效率——文本提取仅需 800 tokens/页，成本比截图方案低 5-13 倍。具备持久化配置文件、ARM64 优化和实时仪表板，是 AI 驱动 Web 自动化的轻量级基础设施。
repos.summary_en: PinchTab is a high-performance browser automation bridge designed for AI agents. This 12MB Go binary delivers HTTP API for multi-instance Chrome orchestration with advanced stealth injection. Its breakthrough is token efficiency—text extraction costs only 800 tokens/page, 5-13x cheaper than screenshots. Featuring persistent profiles, ARM64 optimization, and real-time dashboard, it's the lightweight infrastructure for AI-driven web automation.

repos.description: Agent skills
repos.summary_zh: Jane Street 开源了一套面向 AI 智能体的技能集合，每个技能以 SKILL.md 文件定义指令。首个技能 socratic-tutor 将大模型转化为严格的私人导师，通过诊断、0-5 级技能图谱、逐题提问、间隔复习和最终评估，采用苏格拉底方法系统化教授任意主题。适用于编码智能体或聊天机器人，只需复制技能目录或粘贴指令即可启用。
repos.summary_en: Jane Street open-sources a collection of skills for AI agents, each defined by a SKILL.md file. The first skill, socratic-tutor, turns an LLM into a strict personal tutor that teaches any topic via the Socratic method: diagnosis, a 0-5 level skill map, one question at a time, spaced review, and a final assessment. It works with coding agents or plain chatbots by copying the skill directory or pasting the instructions.

repos.description: Google Cloud Knowledge Catalog Tools and Samples
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供 Google Cloud Knowledge Catalog 的工具、代理与样本。该 AI 驱动数据目录平台通过动态知识图谱整合结构化与非结构化数据，为 AI 代理提供语义和业务上下文。核心包括开放知识格式（OKF）实现可移植 Markdown 知识表示、基于 BigQuery 与 LLM 的富集/发现代理、元数据即代码工具及交互式图谱可视化。适用于企业数据上下文管理、元数据自动化富集与检索解决方案构建。
repos.summary_en: The GoogleCloudPlatform/knowledge-catalog repository delivers tools, agents, and samples for Google Cloud Knowledge Catalog, an AI-powered data catalog and metadata platform. It uses a dynamic knowledge graph to unify structured and unstructured data, providing semantics and business context for AI agents. Key elements include the Open Knowledge Format (OKF) for portable, vendor-neutral markdown-based knowledge; LLM-powered enrichment and discovery agents integrated with BigQuery; Metadata as Code tools; and interactive visualizations. It enables context management, enrichment, and retrieval solutions for enterprise AI applications.

repos.description: The system of action for AI-native cybersecurity—where intent becomes governed execution, evidence becomes operational memory, and every operation improves the next.
repos.summary_zh: CyberStrikeAI是基于Go构建的AI原生网络安全平台，融合Eino多智能体编排（Deep/Plan-Execute/Supervisor）、MCP原生工具、RAG知识库与攻击链建模。它将自然语言意图转化为受治理的可审计安全行动，支持人机协同、资产/漏洞管理及授权渗透测试，适用于红队与安全运营场景。
repos.summary_en: CyberStrikeAI is a Go-based AI-native cybersecurity platform that turns natural-language intent into governed, auditable security actions. It combines Eino multi-agent orchestration (Deep, Plan-Execute, Supervisor), MCP-native tools, RAG knowledge, visual workflows and attack-chain analysis for authorized penetration testing and security operations.

repos.description: The open source AI video agent: turns any coding agent into a video agent, with editors to change anything it makes.
repos.summary_zh: OpenFilm是开源AI视频智能体，可将任意编码智能体转化为视频制作工具。它以单个HTML文件为核心，通过frame(t)函数驱动浏览器渲染每一帧，配合Studio编辑器支持手动或对话式修改视频元素，实现从生成到精剪的完整视频创作流程。
repos.summary_en: OpenFilm is an open-source AI video agent that turns any coding agent into a video maker. Using a single HTML file with a frame(t) function, it renders each frame in the browser via WebGL, canvas, SVG, or CSS. The Studio editor lets you manually or conversationally refine every element, trim clips on the timeline, and render MP4s—enabling end-to-end video creation without frameworks like Remotion. It works with Codex, Claude Code, and other agents.

repos.description: The open-source, privacy-friendly CAPTCHA you host yourself. Bots and AI agents out, people in.
repos.summary_zh: Cap 是一款隐私优先的自托管验证码替代方案，采用 SHA-256 工作量证明机制，摒弃传统视觉 puzzles。仅 20KB 大小，零依赖，加载毫秒级，支持 Docker 独立部署。提供隐形验证与 M2M API 保护能力，通过 CSS 变量实现深度定制，为现代 Web 应用提供高效、私密的 bot 防护。
repos.summary_en: Cap is a privacy-first, self-hosted CAPTCHA alternative that replaces visual puzzles with SHA-256 proof-of-work challenges. At just 20KB with zero dependencies, it loads in milliseconds and supports standalone Docker deployment. Featuring invisible validation, M2M API protection, and CSS variable customization, it provides efficient, private bot mitigation for modern web applications.

repos.description: Ultra-high-performance, secure, all-in-one acceleration engine for developer resources
repos.summary_zh: Xget 是面向开发者的超高性能、安全的一体化加速引擎，专为加速模型、数据集与软件包等资源获取而设计，支持多浏览器扩展与边缘平台部署，并可将资源直接转化为口播视频，无需时间线编辑，显著提升开发与内容创作效率。
repos.summary_en: Xget is an ultra-high-performance, secure, all-in-one acceleration engine for developer resources. It accelerates the retrieval of models, datasets, and packages, supports browser extensions and edge platform deployment, and can turn resources into talking-head videos without timeline editing, boosting development and content creation efficiency.

repos.description: Open Source LLM Gateway 🦚
repos.summary_zh: Manifest 是开源 LLM 网关，专为 AI Agent 与应用设计。通过统一 OpenAI 兼容端点，智能路由 API Key、订阅与本地模型请求至最优模型，支持 300+ 模型与 35+ 提供商。核心能力包括自动降级与故障自愈、全量请求日志、实时成本追踪与限额告警，消除单一供应商锁定，显著提升 Agent 可靠性并降低调用成本。
repos.summary_en: Manifest is an open-source LLM gateway for AI agents and apps. It unifies API keys, subscriptions, and local models behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint, intelligently routing requests to the optimal model across 300+ models and 35+ providers. Key features include automatic fallbacks with self-healing, full request logging, real-time cost tracking, and usage limits—eliminating vendor lock-in while boosting agent reliability and cutting costs.

repos.description: Animated components for design engineers. 150+ free shadcn/ui components, built with Tailwind CSS and Motion. MIT licensed.
repos.summary_zh: 为设计工程师打造的UI组件库，提供92+可复制的AI智能体模式与4个全栈模板。基于Tailwind CSS开发，完全兼容Shadcn，支持一键复制、Next.js导出或v0导入，快速构建可访问的定制化界面。
repos.summary_en: UI component library for Design Engineers featuring 92+ copy-paste AI Agent patterns and 4 full-stack templates. Built with Tailwind CSS, fully Shadcn-compatible. Integrate via copy-paste, Next.js export, or v0 import for accessible, customizable interfaces.

repos.description: DeepAudit：人人拥有的 AI 黑客战队，让漏洞挖掘触手可及。小白一键部署运行，自主协作审计 + 自动化沙箱 PoC 验证。支持 Ollama 私有部署 ，一键生成报告。支持中转站。​让安全不再昂贵，让审计不再复杂。
repos.summary_zh: DeepAudit 是国内首个开源的 AI 多智能体代码审计系统，通过自主协作审计和自动化沙箱 PoC 验证，大幅降低漏洞挖掘门槛。支持 Ollama 私有部署，提供一键式操作和可视化报告，已实战发现 49 个 CVE 漏洞。适用于企业安全自检、开源项目审计和安全研究，让专业级代码审计触手可及。
repos.summary_en: DeepAudit is China's first open-source AI multi-agent code auditing system that democratizes vulnerability discovery through autonomous collaborative auditing and automated sandbox PoC validation. Supporting Ollama private deployment with one-click operation and visual reporting, it has discovered 49 CVEs in production. Ideal for enterprise security self-checks, open-source project auditing, and security research.

repos.description: The world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool and the first to feature concurrent Agent Teams. Design-as-Code. Turn prompts into UI directly on the live canvas. A modern alternative to Pencil.
repos.summary_zh: 全球首个开源AI原生矢量设计工具，首创并发Agent Teams协同架构，支持多模型智能调度与MCP服务。通过自然语言提示实时流式生成UI，提供Design-as-Code的JSON格式，实现跨平台AI驱动的设计到代码全流程。
repos.summary_en: The world's first open-source AI-native vector design tool featuring concurrent Agent Teams for parallel UI generation. Transforms natural language prompts into live canvas designs with streaming animation, offering Design-as-Code JSON format and MCP server integration for cross-platform AI-driven design-to-code workflows.

repos.description: AI Agent Skill (Claude Code, Codex & more): Turn any script into animated stickman videos for faceless YouTube, Shorts & TikTok. 14+ styles with voiceover, captions & SFX. Free & open-source (MIT).
repos.summary_zh: Stickman Video Director是一款Codex Skill工具，利用Gemini Omni Flash将任意文案或创意转化为一分钟火柴人视频完整提示包。包含英文配音脚本、六场景导演计划及6个独立生产提示，支持9:16/16:9/1:1格式与明暗主题。核心亮点为故事架构优化、密集视觉隐喻与镜头运动规划、生产一致性锁定及源素材忠实性。适用于YouTube Shorts、TikTok、Instagram Reels等平台的教育短片、励志故事和视觉解说，通过对话式迭代审批提升短视频创作效率与连贯性。
repos.summary_en: Stickman Video Director is a Codex Skill that transforms any copy or idea into a complete one-minute stickman video prompt package using Gemini Omni Flash. It produces a confirmed English voiceover, a detailed six-scene director's proposal, and six standalone production-ready prompts. Supports 9:16, 16:9, and 1:1 formats with light/dark themes. Key highlights include stronger story architecture, dense motion planning with metaphors and camera moves, production consistency locks across prompts, format-aware direction, and source fidelity. Ideal for educational shorts, motivational stories, and visual explainers on YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube via conversational iterative approval.

repos.description: MaiSaka, an LLM-based intelligent agent, is a digital lifeform devoted to understanding you and interacting in the style of a real human. She does not pursue perfection, nor does she seek efficiency; instead, she values warmth, authenticity, and genuine connection.
repos.summary_zh: 麦麦MaiBot是基于大语言模型的交互式智能体，定位为数字生命，致力于以真实人类风格互动，追求温暖、真实与连接而非完美或效率。核心亮点包括自然闲聊风格、群聊氛围感知与风格模仿、基于人格理论的用户画像积累，以及强大插件扩展系统。适用于个性化陪伴、智能对话和群聊参与等场景，提供更人性化的AI体验。
repos.summary_en: MaiBot (MaiSaka) is an LLM-powered interactive agent designed as a digital lifeform that engages in authentic human-like interactions, prioritizing warmth, authenticity, and genuine connection over perfection or efficiency. Key highlights include natural conversational styles, reading the room in group chats while mimicking styles and learning slang, building user profiles via personality theory, and a robust plugin system for extensibility. Ideal for personal companionship, immersive group conversations, and customizable AI experiences.

repos.description: The control plane for 24/7 always-on agents. Turn long-horizon goals into verifiable results across Codex, Claude Code, and custom runtimes—from local SQLite to team scale.
repos.summary_zh: LoopX是开源、提供商中立的本地优先控制平面，专为长周期AI智能体设计。它作为轻量状态内核运行于Codex、Claude Code等框架之上，持久保存目标、闸门、待办、证据与交接，提供治理、恢复与人机协作能力，使长时任务可审查、可重启并跨工具安全交接。
repos.summary_en: LoopX is an open, provider-neutral, local-first control plane for long-horizon AI agents. It layers a lightweight state kernel atop harnesses like Codex and Claude Code, preserving objectives, gates, todos, evidence and handoffs across turns while enabling governance, recovery and human-agent collaboration for durable, reviewable work.

repos.description: Build your autonomous hedge fund in minutes. AutoHedge harnesses the power of swarm intelligence and AI agents to automate market analysis, risk management, and trade execution.
repos.summary_zh: AutoHedge 是一个基于群体智能的多代理AI系统，可自动化构建对冲基金。系统采用Director、Quant、Risk Manager、Execution四层代理架构，实现从市场分析、策略生成到风险控制和交易执行的全流程自主化。目前支持Solana链上全自动交易，采用风险优先设计，提供结构化输出和企业级日志，适用于机构级量化交易场景。
repos.summary_en: AutoHedge is an enterprise-grade autonomous hedge fund platform powered by swarm intelligence and multi-agent AI systems. It orchestrates specialized agents for market analysis, strategy generation, risk management, and trade execution in a risk-first pipeline. Currently supporting full autonomous trading on Solana, it features structured JSON outputs, comprehensive logging, and modular architecture for institutional-grade quantitative trading with minimal human intervention.

repos.description: A compact Agent Skill for highly simplified, rounded, subtly neo-skeuomorphic IP mascot logos.
repos.summary_zh: 紧凑型Agent Skill，专为AI智能体生成极度简化、圆润可爱的公司级IP吉祥物。强调4-7个基本形状的粗壮剪影、三色语义配色、下角主导构图与微妙新拟物深度，兼容Codex、Coze、Doubao等主流Agent及顶级图像模型，输出可商用的可爱方图。
repos.summary_en: A compact Agent Skill that enables AI agents to generate extremely simple, cute, company-ready IP mascot logos. It enforces bold rounded silhouettes from 4–7 shapes, three semantic colors, lower-corner dominance and subtle neo-skeuomorphic depth. Compatible with Codex, Coze, Doubao and top image models; produces commercially usable square character assets.

repos.description: Remove visible and invisible AI watermarks from images and video, and AI provenance metadata from images, video, and audio. Python library, CLI, and agent skill for SynthID, C2PA, EXIF, IPTC, XMP, and common generative-AI marks. By Victor Kuznetsov.
repos.summary_zh: 这个仓库提供CLI和库，用于移除AI生成图像的可见和不可见水印。支持Gemini、DALL-E、Stable Diffusion等主流模型，采用反向alpha混合算法快速移除Gemini的sparkle logo，通过扩散模型再生消除SynthID等不可见水印，并剥离C2PA、EXIF等元数据。具备智能人脸保护和批量处理能力，可绕过社交媒体AI检测。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a comprehensive CLI and library solution for removing both visible and invisible AI watermarks from images generated by major models such as Google Gemini, OpenAI DALL-E, Stable Diffusion, Adobe Firefly, and Midjourney. It employs a novel reverse alpha blending algorithm to deterministically remove the Gemini/Nano Banana sparkle logo in under 0.05 seconds without GPU requirements, using a three-stage NCC detector for dynamic positioning. For invisible watermarks including SynthID, StableSignature, and TreeRing, it utilizes diffusion-based regeneration at native SDXL resolution (~1024px) with controlled noise addition and denoising. The tool comprehensively strips AI metadata (C2PA manifests, EXIF, XMP, PNG text chunks), removes "Made with AI" labels that trigger social media flags, and features Smart Face Protection to prevent AI distortion. Additional capabilities include Analog Humanizer adding film grain to bypass AI classifiers and efficient batch processing for directories.

repos.description: Open-source auth gateway connecting 1700+ SaaS providers to AI agents through SDK, CLI, MCP, HTTP, and OpenAPI.
repos.summary_zh: OpenConnector 是开源 AI 智能体连接网关，替代 Pipedream/Composio。一次授权连接 1500+ SaaS（GitHub、Gmail、Notion 等），通过 SDK、CLI、MCP、HTTP/OpenAPI 暴露 10000+ 预置 Actions。支持凭证管理、可检查 Action 契约、策略控制与运行日志，可自托管（Docker/Node/K8s）或使用 OOMOL 托管运行时。
repos.summary_en: OpenConnector is an open-source auth gateway for AI agents, an alternative to Pipedream/Composio. Connect 1500+ SaaS providers once and expose 10,000+ prebuilt Actions via SDK, CLI, MCP, HTTP and OpenAPI. It handles credentials, inspectable contracts, policies and logs, supporting self-hosting (Docker/Node/K8s) or OOMOL-hosted runtime.

repos.description: A library of behaviors for agents to build the next generation of user interfaces.
repos.summary_zh: UI SDK 是一个为 AI 智能体设计的用户界面行为库，提供键盘导航、焦点管理、选择、弹出、拖放等交互行为，并内置 ARIA 无障碍支持。通过 @ui-sdk/core 定义原始组件，可无缝适配 React、Vue、Svelte、Solid 和 Web Components，助力智能体快速生成下一代 UI。
repos.summary_en: UI SDK is a library of behaviors for AI agents to build next-generation user interfaces. It provides keyboard navigation, focus, selection, dismissal, popups, drag-and-drop, and ARIA accessibility. Built on @ui-sdk/core, it offers adapters for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, and Web Components, enabling agents to generate UIs seamlessly.

repos.description: Open-source, desktop-grade AI agent that gets real work done — data analysis, slides, docs, video & web research. Built on OpenClaw; runs tools on your real desktop and takes commands from your phone via WeChat, Feishu, DingTalk & Telegram.
repos.summary_zh: 网易有道推出的LobsterAI是一款24/7全场景AI个人助理，基于Electron+React构建跨平台桌面应用。核心采用Cowork模式，支持本地或Alpine沙盒环境执行任务，内置Office文档生成、Playwright自动化、Remotion视频生成等技能。通过Telegram/Discord/DingTalk/Feishu实现移动端远程控制，具备持久化记忆与权限审批机制，覆盖数据分析、PPT制作、邮件处理等办公场景。
repos.summary_en: LobsterAI by NetEase Youdao is a 24/7 all-scenario AI personal assistant built on Electron+React. Its core Cowork mode executes tasks in local or Alpine sandbox environments, featuring built-in skills like Office document generation, Playwright automation, and Remotion video creation. It enables remote control via IM platforms (Telegram/Discord/DingTalk/Feishu), persistent memory, permission gating, and covers productivity scenarios including data analysis, presentation creation, and email management.

repos.description: Matt Pocock skills 的简体中文本地化：人工审核每一次更新，定期同步上游，支持 Claude、Codex 和 DSH 插件。
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库是 mattpocock/skills 的简体中文本地化版本，旨在更好适配中文大语言模型和中文开发者。采用 skill-guided content localization 策略，仅翻译自然语言说明，保留技能名、命令、代码块和路径不变，确保安装运行完全兼容。提供工程、生产力等领域的 AI 技能，支持中文提示工程，降低概念转换成本，方便中文开发流程与 coding agent 集成。同步上游更新并通过翻译验证。
repos.summary_en: This repository is the Simplified Chinese localization of mattpocock/skills, optimized for Chinese large language models and native developers. It applies a skill-guided content localization strategy, translating only natural language while preserving skill names, commands, code blocks, paths, and identifiers to ensure full installation and runtime compatibility. It delivers AI skills across engineering and productivity domains, enabling Chinese prompt engineering with reduced cognitive load and seamless integration into Chinese development workflows. Updates are synced from upstream with rigorous validation.

repos.description: An open-source vibe coding platform that helps you build your own vibe-coding platform, built entirely on Cloudflare stack
repos.summary_zh: Cloudflare VibeSDK 是基于 Cloudflare 全栈生态的开源 AI 应用生成平台。它允许企业通过自然语言描述自动生成 React+TS+Tailwind 应用，并一键部署至 Workers。核心亮点包括 AI 智能纠错、沙箱实时预览、多 LLM 网关集成，以及可定制的组件库支持，适用于构建内部工具、SaaS 扩展和客户赋能平台。
repos.summary_en: Cloudflare VibeSDK is an open-source AI-powered full-stack app generator built entirely on Cloudflare's developer platform. It enables natural language-driven React+TypeScript+Tailwind application creation with one-click deployment to Workers. Key features include AI error correction, sandboxed live previews, multi-LLM gateway integration, and customizable component libraries—ideal for internal tools, SaaS extensions, and customer-facing AI platforms.

repos.description: Persistent memory for Claude Code, Codex and 6 other AI agents, stored as plain markdown in your Obsidian vault. New: Crew, one shared logbook so Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Grok Bot know what each other did. 48 commands: semantic search, self-rewriting notes, key-less research, scheduled agents.
repos.summary_zh: obsidian-second-brain 将 Obsidian vault 转变为跨 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini 和 OpenCode 四 CLI 的活 AI 第二大脑。43 命令实现笔记自重写、自动知识合成、实时网络/X/YouTube 研究、/obsidian-architect 代码文档化、Google Calendar 集成及反幻觉机制。基于 Karpathy LLM Wiki 模式，vault 自我更新并调和矛盾，助力构建不断进化的个人知识系统。
repos.summary_en: obsidian-second-brain transforms your Obsidian vault into a living AI-first second brain across Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and OpenCode. With 43 commands, it delivers self-rewriting notes that update existing pages and auto-reconcile contradictions, following Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Features include live research from web/X/YouTube, /obsidian-architect for codebase docs, keyless research, Google Calendar integration, scheduled agents, role presets, and anti-hallucination tools, enabling autonomous knowledge compounding.

repos.description: Recursive-Open-Meta-Agent v0.1 (Beta). A meta-agent framework to build high-performance multi-agent systems.
repos.summary_zh: ROMA是一个递归开放元代理框架，专注于构建高性能分层多智能体系统。该框架通过元代理架构实现智能体的递归组合与层次化管理，支持复杂任务的自动分解与协同执行。核心价值在于简化多智能体系统的构建流程，提供可扩展的递归设计模式，适用于需要动态编排和高效协作的AI应用场景。技术亮点包括分层代理治理、递归任务分解和开放扩展机制，为构建下一代智能系统提供基础设施。
repos.summary_en: ROMA is a Recursive Open Meta-Agent framework designed for building high-performance hierarchical multi-agent systems. It enables recursive composition and hierarchical management of agents through meta-agent architecture, supporting automatic decomposition and collaborative execution of complex tasks. The framework simplifies multi-agent system development with extensible recursive design patterns, ideal for AI applications requiring dynamic orchestration and efficient coordination. Key technical features include hierarchical agent governance, recursive task decomposition, and open extensibility mechanisms, providing robust infrastructure for building next-generation intelligent agent ecosystems with high scalability.

repos.description: Curated list of the best truly open-source AI projects, models, tools, and infrastructure. Daily updated.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个全面收录高质量开源AI项目的精选列表，涵盖核心框架、基础模型、推理引擎、AI代理、RAG、MLOps等14大类别。为开发者提供从研究到生产落地的完整技术栈导航，助力快速发现与集成前沿开源AI工具，推动AI技术民主化。
repos.summary_en: A comprehensive curated list of high-quality truly open-source AI projects, models, tools, and infrastructure spanning 14 categories from core frameworks to production deployment. Covers the entire AI technology stack including foundation models, inference engines, agentic AI systems, RAG, MLOps, and AI safety tools. Serves as an essential developer resource for discovering, evaluating, and integrating cutting-edge open-source AI solutions, significantly lowering barriers to AI adoption and fostering innovation through open collaboration.

repos.description: OpenKB: Open LLM Knowledge Base
repos.summary_zh: OpenKB是开源CLI的LLM知识库系统，通过编译文档构建结构化wiki，支持PageIndex无向量长文档检索与推理。知识一次性持久化积累，自动生成摘要、概念页与交叉引用，优于传统RAG每次重算。兼容多LLM、多模态输入及Skill Factory蒸馏专家技能。适用于知识管理、学术研究与智能体构建场景。
repos.summary_en: OpenKB is an open-source CLI system that uses LLMs to compile raw documents into a structured, interlinked wiki-style knowledge base. Powered by PageIndex for vectorless long-document retrieval and reasoning, it compiles knowledge once into a persistent wiki with automatic summaries, concepts, and cross-references—unlike traditional RAG. Supports multi-LLM via LiteLLM, multi-modality, query/chat, and Skill Factory for portable expert skills. Ideal for knowledge management, research, and AI agent development.

repos.description: Lossless Claw — LCM (Lossless Context Management) plugin for OpenClaw
repos.summary_zh: Lossless Claw 是 OpenClaw 的无损上下文管理插件，基于 LCM 论文实现。它通过 DAG 结构摘要系统解决 AI 代理长对话的 token 限制问题，将所有消息持久化到 SQLite 数据库，并使用 LLM 动态生成多层次摘要，确保对话历史完整可查。提供搜索工具让代理随时召回细节，实现永不遗忘的智能体体验。
repos.summary_en: Lossless Claw is a Lossless Context Management (LCM) plugin for OpenClaw that solves AI agents' context window limitations through innovative DAG-based summarization. Instead of truncating old messages, it persists every message in SQLite and creates hierarchical LLM-generated summaries, forming a directed acyclic graph that preserves all original details. The system dynamically assembles context by combining recent messages with relevant summaries, ensuring no information is ever lost. With built-in tools like lcm_grep and lcm_expand, agents can instantly search and retrieve any historical detail, delivering a seamless never-forget conversational experience while staying within model token constraints.

repos.description: AI You Control: Choose your models. Own your data. Eliminate vendor lock-in.
repos.summary_zh: Thunderbolt 是 Mozilla 开源的跨平台 AI 客户端，主打'AI You Control'理念。支持本地部署，兼容 Ollama、llama.cpp 等本地推理引擎及 OpenAI 兼容 API，彻底摆脱供应商锁定。提供桌面、移动端全覆盖，面向企业客户，支持私有化部署，强调数据主权与安全可控，目前处于安全审计阶段，即将企业就绪。
repos.summary_en: Thunderbolt is Mozilla's open-source, cross-platform AI client championing 'AI You Control' with full vendor lock-in elimination. It supports local deployment, integrates with Ollama, llama.cpp and OpenAI-compatible APIs, ensuring data ownership. Available across desktop and mobile platforms, it targets enterprise on-premise deployment with enhanced security and privacy, currently undergoing security audit for production readiness.

repos.description: OpenRAG is a comprehensive, single package Retrieval-Augmented Generation platform built on Langflow, Docling, and Opensearch.
repos.summary_zh: OpenRAG是基于Langflow、Docling和OpenSearch的开箱即用RAG平台，提供智能文档搜索与AI对话能力。支持可视化工作流构建、多Agent协调与企业级语义检索，可快速部署处理真实数据，实现生产级企业知识管理。
repos.summary_en: OpenRAG is a production-ready RAG platform integrating Langflow, Docling, and OpenSearch for intelligent document search and AI conversations. It features visual workflow orchestration, multi-agent coordination, and enterprise-grade semantic retrieval, enabling rapid deployment on messy real-world data.

repos.description: skill to create best prompts for generating videos with seedance2.0
repos.summary_zh: 该GitHub仓库提供针对字节跳动Seedance 2.0多模态AI视频生成模型的提示词撰写技能，专为Claude等AI智能体设计。核心包括输入约束、@引用语法、镜头语言、提示结构模式及多场景模板，覆盖广告、戏剧、MV和教育内容。基于官方文档，助力用户通过结构化提示工程高效生成高质量视频提示，提升AI视频创作的专业水平与效率。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides specialized skills for AI agents to craft optimal prompts for ByteDance's Seedance 2.0 multimodal video generation model. It covers input constraints, @ reference syntax, camera language, prompt structures, and ready-to-use templates for ads, dramas, MVs, and educational content. Based on official docs, it enables efficient high-quality prompt engineering in tools like Claude Code and Cursor, boosting video output across creative and commercial scenarios.

repos.description: Collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace: aggregate sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok Build, etc. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.
repos.summary_zh: Codeg 是多智能体 AI 编程协作工作区，统一聚合 Claude Code、Codex、Grok Build 等十余种 AI 编码代理，支持跨代理会话迁移与 @ 委派协作，提供桌面端、自托管服务器、Docker 及移动端全平台部署，让多个 AI 代理在同一结构化界面中协同完成开发任务。
repos.summary_en: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace that unifies 15+ AI coding agents—Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, OpenCode, and more—into a single structured conversation interface with live diffs and project file browsing. It supports cross-agent session import, search, and transfer, plus @-delegation for inter-agent task collaboration in isolated worktrees. Deployable as a desktop app, self-hosted server, Docker container, or mobile apps for iOS and Android, with integrations for Telegram, Lark, and WeChat for remote access.

repos.description: 把 Markdown 一键排成可直接粘进公众号编辑器的精致 HTML —— 6 套精选主题 + 主题生成器 + 双关卡校验。An AI-agent skill that turns Markdown into paste-ready WeChat article HTML.
repos.summary_zh: gzh-design-skill 是一个专为 AI Agent 设计的公众号排版技能，将 Markdown 一键转为微信编辑器兼容的内联 HTML。内置 6 套精选主题及主题生成器，支持自动章节编号、关键词下划线、代码块图片 GIF 处理，并通过 Python 双重校验脚本确保质量。适用于教程测评、深度分析、数据报告等场景，规避平台格式限制，实现确定性高质量输出，提升内容创作效率。
repos.summary_en: gzh-design-skill is an AI-agent skill that converts Markdown into paste-ready, inline-styled HTML optimized for the WeChat public account editor. It features 6 curated themes, a theme generator, automatic chapter numbering, keyword highlighting, code block/image/GIF support, and dual Python validation scripts. Ideal for tutorials, reviews, analyses, and reports, it ensures WeChat compatibility and deterministic quality for agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor.

repos.description: AI-Powered Python & Python-Powered AI (Python-Use)
repos.summary_zh: Python-Use 提出了一种名为 'AI Think Do' 的 AI Agent 2.0 新范式，旨在取代依赖外部插件和复杂工作流的传统 Agent 1.0 架构。其核心思想是将完整的 Python 解释器环境直接交给 LLM，让模型通过自主编写、调试和执行 Python 代码来直接操作真实环境（如数据、浏览器、文件系统），从而实现任务驱动的端到端自动化。该方案摒弃了 MCP、Function Calling 和插件注册等中间层，强调 'Code is Agent'，以极简架构释放 AI 的原生执行能力。
repos.summary_en: Python-Use introduces a novel AI Agent 2.0 paradigm called 'AI Think Do', designed to replace traditional Agent 1.0 architectures reliant on external plugins and complex workflows. Its core principle is providing LLMs direct access to a full Python interpreter, enabling them to autonomously write, debug, and execute code to interact with real environments (data, browsers, file systems) for task-driven end-to-end automation. It eliminates intermediate layers like MCP, Function Calling, and plugin registration, advocating 'Code is Agent' to unleash native AI execution capabilities with a minimalist architecture.

repos.description: Help AI coding agents write modern Go
repos.summary_zh: JetBrains/go-modern-guidelines 为 AI 编码代理提供 Go 现代编程指南。从 go.mod 自动检测项目 Go 版本，使用 1.0-1.27 最新特性（slices.Contains、cmp.Or、errors.AsType[T] 等）。规避训练数据滞后和频率偏见，生成简洁高效代码，减少后续维护。涵盖 modernize 分析器全部目标功能，适用于 Junie、Claude Code、Cursor 等代理。
repos.summary_en: JetBrains/go-modern-guidelines provides Go modern coding guidelines for AI coding agents. Automatically detects project Go version from go.mod and uses latest features from 1.0 to 1.27 (e.g., slices.Contains, cmp.Or, errors.AsType[T]). Avoids training data lag and frequency bias, generating clean and efficient code with minimal maintenance. Covers all targets of the modernize analyzer; integrates with Junie, Claude Code, Cursor and others.

repos.description: Curated list of AI-powered developer tools.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库系统性地整理了AI驱动的开发者工具生态，覆盖智能IDE、终端代理到自动化CI/CD的全链路场景。核心价值在于通过LLM增强代码生成、重构与调试效率，并引入多智能体编排和沙箱隔离技术实现安全自治。典型应用包括Cursor/Windsurf等AI-Native编辑器、PR审查机器人及数据库智能助手，是开发者迈向AI编程时代的导航地图。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates an ecosystem of AI-powered developer tools spanning intelligent IDEs, terminal agents, and automated CI/CD pipelines. It enhances coding efficiency through LLM-driven generation, refactoring, and debugging, while introducing multi-agent orchestration and sandboxing for secure autonomy. Key applications include AI-native editors like Cursor/Windsurf, PR review bots, and database assistants, serving as a roadmap for developers transitioning to AI-augmented programming.

repos.description: De-AI writing skill for any Agent Skills-compatible agent (77+ via the Skills CLI), with native plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, and Antigravity. Narrative-architecture repair for fiction, venue-matched rules for professional prose. Based on StoryScope (arXiv:2604.03136).
repos.summary_zh: sepia 是可移植的 Agent Skill，基于 StoryScope 研究，从叙事架构层消除 AI 写作痕迹。小说先修复因果与主题结构，再处理篇章与字句；专业文按场景（发版说明、PR、事故复盘等）匹配规则。支持 77+ 代理及 Claude Code、Codex、Grok 等原生插件，提供写、审、改、重写四种操作。
repos.summary_en: sepia is a portable Agent Skill that de-AIs writing at the architectural layer, based on StoryScope research. Fiction repairs narrative structure before style; professional prose applies venue-matched rules for release notes, PRs, postmortems and more. Works with 77+ agents via Skills CLI, plus native plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build and others, offering write, review, refactor and recreate operations.

repos.description: 全能协议分析工具：浏览器抓包 + MITM 代理 + 指纹伪装 + AI 分析 + MCP Server 无缝对接 AI Agent/IDE   |  All-in-one protocol analysis toolkit — built-in browser capture, MITM proxy, JS hooks, fingerprint spoofing, AI analysis & MCP server for agent integration
repos.summary_zh: Anything Analyzer是一款全能协议分析工具，集成内嵌浏览器抓包、MITM代理、JS Hook与AI大模型，支持网页、桌面应用、终端脚本及手机App的全场景流量捕获，所有请求统一汇入Session。AI实现两阶段智能分析、API逆向、安全审计、加密代码提取与流式报告，内置MCP Server/Client无缝对接AI Agent和IDE。基于Electron+React+TypeScript的跨平台桌面应用，显著提升协议逆向与调试效率。
repos.summary_en: Anything Analyzer is an all-in-one protocol analysis toolkit combining embedded browser capture (CDP), MITM proxy, JS hooks for fingerprint spoofing and encryption interception, and AI-powered analysis. It unifies traffic from websites, desktop apps, terminals, scripts, and mobile apps into sessions for automated API reverse engineering, security audits, JS encryption reversal, and more. Built-in MCP server/client enables seamless integration with AI agents and IDEs like Claude and Cursor. Developed with Electron, React, and TypeScript, it provides a cross-platform desktop solution to streamline protocol analysis and debugging.

repos.description: Deep dive into Claude Code internals — architecture, agent loop, context engineering, and more. / 深入解析 Claude Code 源码：架构、Agent 循环、上下文工程、工具系统等
repos.summary_zh: 这个项目深入解析Claude Code的50万行TypeScript源码，揭示其百万级DAU生产系统的架构设计。核心亮点包括：4级渐进式上下文压缩解决token限制，5层纵深防御保障安全执行，工具预执行与全链路流式输出实现极致性能，以及静默恢复机制提升用户体验。适合AI Agent开发者和架构师学习。
repos.summary_en: This project provides a comprehensive analysis of Claude Code's 500,000-line TypeScript source codebase, revealing the engineering architecture powering this leading AI programming agent. It dissects critical production-grade designs: 4-level progressive context compression managing token constraints, 5-layer security system preventing dangerous operations, tool pre-execution with full streaming pipeline for perceived performance, and silent recovery mechanisms with 7 retry strategies. The 12-chapter documentation covers agent loops, context engineering, and tool orchestration, serving as a valuable resource for developers building production AI agents.

repos.description: List of 67 awesome DESIGN.md and SKILL.md design skill files for agentic tools like Claude Design, Google Stitch, Codex, Cursor, and other AI tools
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库为Claude Code、Cursor等AI编程助手提供67个结构化设计系统技能文件。每个技能包含SKILL.md（AI可读的组件规范、可访问性约束、质量标准）和DESIGN.md（人类可读的设计意图）。通过TypeUI CLI一键集成，确保AI生成UI符合品牌规范、设计一致性与WCAG 2.2 AA标准，实现AI辅助开发中设计质量与效率的质的飞跃。
repos.summary_en: A curated registry of 67 design system skill files specifically engineered for AI coding agents including Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. Each skill delivers structured instructions via SKILL.md (machine-readable component rules, accessibility constraints, quality gates) and DESIGN.md (human-readable rationale and maintenance notes). The TypeUI CLI enables one-command integration directly into projects, ensuring AI-generated UIs automatically adhere to brand guidelines, design consistency, and WCAG 2.2 AA compliance. This fundamentally transforms AI-assisted development by embedding design system intelligence into agent workflows, enabling rapid prototyping at scale while maintaining human oversight and quality control.

repos.summary_zh: dg-ai-notes 是冬瓜的 AI 学习笔记仓库，专注 Pi-Agent SDK 深度教程。Pi-Agent 作为生产级 AI Agent 运行时底座，提供 Agent Loop、工具系统、消息系统、事件驱动及会话管理等核心能力。教程分 10 章系统拆解源码设计，每章涵盖概念、实现与设计取舍，提供 TypeScript 和 Python 双版本对照，支持在线 Web 阅读、Markdown 下载、PDF 及 Notebook 实验。帮助开发者理解生产级 Agent 架构，搭建可靠 AI 应用。
repos.summary_en: dg-ai-notes is Winter Melon's AI learning notes repo focused on an in-depth tutorial for the Pi-Agent SDK. Pi-Agent is a production-grade runtime base for AI Agents, featuring Agent Loop, tool system, messaging, event-driven architecture, and session management. The 10-chapter tutorial dissects source code design with both TypeScript and Python versions, offering web reading, Markdown/PDF downloads, and an interactive notebook. It helps developers understand and build reliable AI Agent systems.

repos.description: GDM Science Skills to speed up agentic scientific workflows with better grounding and higher token efficiency. Integrate insights from AlphaGenome, AFDB, UniProt and 30+ other databases and tools.
repos.summary_zh: google-deepmind/science-skills 是 Google DeepMind 推出的科学技能集合，旨在加速 AI 智能体的科学工作流。它集成 AlphaGenome、AFDB、UniProt 等 30+ 数据库和工具，提供结构化指令、脚本资源，提升事实 grounding 和 token 效率。技能 spanning 基因组学、结构生物学、化学信息学及文献检索等领域，与 Google Antigravity 深度集成，助力高效科研任务。
repos.summary_en: The google-deepmind/science-skills repo delivers a bundle of agent skills from Google DeepMind to enhance scientific workflows for AI agents. It integrates over 30 databases and tools like AlphaGenome, AFDB, and UniProt, offering structured instructions and scripts for better grounding and token efficiency. Covering genomics, structural biology, cheminformatics, and literature search, these skills are optimized for the Google Antigravity platform, improving reliability and enabling efficient scientific automation.

repos.description: Stealth browser automation for AI agents over MCP and the Chrome DevTools Protocol: navigation, network hooks, DOM extraction, and pixel-accurate UI cloning.
repos.summary_zh: Stealth Browser MCP 是专为 MCP 兼容 AI 智能体打造的不可检测浏览器自动化框架。基于 nodriver 与 Chrome DevTools Protocol，能有效绕过 Cloudflare、Queue-It 等反爬系统。核心亮点包括像素完美 UI 元素克隆（提取完整 CSS/DOM/事件）、网络流量拦截与 AI 动态生成 Python 钩子实现实时修改。提供 97 个模块化工具，支持最小化部署与跨平台运行（Windows/macOS/Linux/Docker）。无缝集成 Claude、Cursor 等 MCP 客户端，通过自然语言聊天执行高级浏览器任务，适用于受保护网站的网页抓取、自动化测试与数据提取。
repos.summary_en: Stealth Browser MCP delivers undetectable browser automation for MCP-compatible AI agents. Powered by nodriver and Chrome DevTools Protocol, it bypasses Cloudflare, Queue-It, and other anti-bot systems. Highlights include pixel-accurate UI cloning with full CSS/DOM extraction, comprehensive network interception, and an AI-driven dynamic hook system for real-time traffic modification via generated Python functions. It features 97 modular tools with minimal/core modes, cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux, Docker), and seamless integration with Claude, Cursor, and other MCP clients. Enables natural language control for stealth web scraping, automated testing, and interactions on protected sites.

repos.description: AGENTS.md rules / skills for AI coding agents: Codex, Cursor & Claude Code. Inspired by Clean Code, Refactoring, DDD, Clean Architecture and DDIA programming books.
repos.summary_zh: 本仓库将经典软件工程著作（如Clean Code、DDD、DDIA）提炼为AI编程智能体（Cursor、Claude Code、Codex）可执行的规则集。提供full/mini/nano三版本适配不同上下文窗口，注入工程化思维与架构治理，提升AI生成代码的质量与可维护性。
repos.summary_en: This repository distills classic software engineering books (Clean Code, DDD, DDIA) into executable rule sets for AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex). It provides three versions (full/mini/nano) to fit different context windows, injecting engineering mindset and architecture governance into AI-generated code. The tool-agnostic Markdown format enhances code quality and maintainability while supporting editor-specific configurations for optimal AI-assisted development.

repos.description: Give your AI agent access to your live Chrome session — works out of the box, connects to tabs you already have open
repos.summary_zh: 让AI智能体直接操控正在使用的Chrome浏览器，无需重新登录或启动新实例。通过Chrome原生调试协议建立持久连接，支持截图、DOM操作、网络监控等能力。相比Puppeteer方案，可访问已登录状态，稳定处理百个标签页，适合需要与真实浏览器环境交互的智能体场景。
repos.summary_en: Enables AI agents to directly control your live Chrome session without relogin or new instances. Establishes persistent connections via Chrome's native debugging protocol, supporting screenshots, DOM manipulation, and network monitoring. Unlike Puppeteer-based solutions, it accesses authenticated states and reliably handles 100+ tabs, ideal for agents interacting with real browser environments.

repos.description: Agent skills and an AI-native SwiftUI component library for iOS apps: animations, Metal shaders, charts, components and full-stack modules your coding agent can build from.
repos.summary_zh: ShipSwift 是一个 AI 原生的 SwiftUI 组件库，提供生产就绪的动画、图表、UI 组件和全栈模块配方。通过 MCP 服务器或本地技能安装，AI 工具如 Claude、Cursor 可即时获取代码与上下文，快速构建真实 iOS 应用。兼容 30+ AI 编码助手，含可搜索目录和 App Store 展示 App，还提供自定义开发服务。适用于加速原生 iOS 开发与 AI 辅助编程。
repos.summary_en: ShipSwift is an AI-native SwiftUI component library providing production-ready components and full-stack recipes for animations, charts, UI elements, and modules. Via MCP server or local skills, AI tools like Claude and Cursor instantly access code and context to build real iOS apps. Compatible with 30+ AI coding assistants, it includes a searchable catalog, App Store showcase app, and custom development services. Accelerates native iOS development with AI assistance for Swift 5.0+ and iOS 18+.

repos.description: Autonomous penetration testing using a swarm of AI agents. Orchestrates recon, classification, exploitation, and reporting specialists with ReAct reasoning — supports bug bounty, continuous monitoring, and CTF modes. Built with Go and 7+ native security tools.
repos.summary_zh: Pentest Swarm AI是首个基于真实群体架构的开源渗透测试工具，通过AI代理群协同完成侦察、分类、利用和报告全流程。支持漏洞赏金、持续监控和CTF模式，集成nmap、sqlmap、Burp等7+原生安全工具，兼容Claude、Ollama等多种大模型，采用ReAct推理实现真正自主化的安全测试。
repos.summary_en: Pentest Swarm AI is the first open-source penetration testing tool built on a real swarm architecture, orchestrating specialized AI agents for reconnaissance, classification, exploitation, and reporting. Supporting bug bounty programs, continuous monitoring, and CTF competitions, it integrates 7+ native security tools including nmap, sqlmap, Burp, and Metasploit. Built with Go and ReAct reasoning, it's compatible with Claude, Ollama, and other LLMs, enabling truly autonomous security testing through stigmergic multi-agent coordination.

repos.description: Curated tools, case studies and papers for reverse engineering websites, games, apps, binaries, firmware and protocols. Source-reviewed, English and Chinese.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库汇集了网站、游戏、应用、二进制、固件和协议等六大领域的逆向工程工具、案例与论文，共5000余项资源，均经来源审查，支持中英双语，为安全研究、漏洞挖掘和软件分析提供一站式导航。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates tools, case studies, and papers for reverse engineering websites, games, apps, binaries, firmware, and protocols. With over 5,000 resources, all source-reviewed and bilingual, it serves as a comprehensive hub for security research, vulnerability discovery, and software analysis.

repos.description: 🏆 Top-1 on 5+ benchmarks | Web UI | Supports MiroThinker, Claude, Kimi, OpenAI
repos.summary_zh: MiroFlow 是一款性能优先的开源 AI 智能体框架，在 9+ 基准测试中提升任意大模型性能。支持 GPT-5、Claude、Kimi 等模型一键切换，通过智能回滚、迭代推理和工具编排优化表现。提供 FastAPI+React Web 界面、无代码技能系统和多智能体图工作流，适用于模型评估、智能体研发与生产部署，结果完全可复现。
repos.summary_en: MiroFlow is a performance-first open-source AI agent framework that enhances any LLM's capabilities across 9+ benchmarks. It enables one-line model switching between GPT-5, Claude, Kimi, and others via YAML config, optimizing performance through smart rollback, iterative reasoning, and tool orchestration. Features include a FastAPI+React Web UI, code-free skill system, and multi-agent graph workflows, ideal for model evaluation, agent development, and production deployment with fully reproducible results.

repos.description: QuantMind is an open source agent-native knowledge extraction and retrieval framework for quantitative finance.
repos.summary_zh: QuantMind是面向量化金融的智能知识提取与检索框架，将论文、新闻、报告等非结构化内容转化为语义知识图谱。采用两阶段架构：提取阶段通过多模态解析、领域特定LLM和智能代理实现结构化、标签化与去重；检索阶段支持嵌入向量、RAG、多跳推理等场景。适用于对冲基金、机构投资者快速探索因子策略与市场洞见，提升研究效率并挖掘Alpha。获NeurIPS 2025 GenAI in Finance Workshop接受。
repos.summary_en: QuantMind is an intelligent knowledge extraction and retrieval framework for quantitative finance. It transforms unstructured content such as papers, news, reports, and SEC filings into a semantic knowledge graph. Built on a decoupled two-stage architecture, the extraction stage uses multi-modal parsing, domain-specific LLMs, tagging, and agentic workflows for structuring and deduplication; the retrieval stage enables embeddings, RAG, DeepResearch multi-hop reasoning, and knowledge-aware generation. Ideal for hedge funds and research teams to accelerate factor and risk model discovery. Accepted at NeurIPS 2025 GenAI in Finance Workshop.

repos.description: DeepTeam is a framework to red team LLMs and AI agents.
repos.summary_zh: DeepTeam是开源的LLM红队测试框架，专为AI系统提供安全渗透测试。它通过模拟越狱、提示注入等50+攻击方式，检测AI代理、RAG和聊天机器人中的隐私泄露、偏见等漏洞。基于DeepEval构建，支持本地运行LLM-as-a-Judge评估，并提供生产环境防护护栏，助力AI系统安全加固。
repos.summary_en: DeepTeam is an open-source red teaming framework designed for LLM systems, functioning as penetration testing for AI. It simulates over 50 attacks like jailbreaking and prompt injection to uncover vulnerabilities such as data leakage and bias in AI agents, RAG pipelines, and chatbots. Built on DeepEval, it runs locally with LLM-as-a-Judge metrics and offers guardrails for production security, strengthening AI system resilience.

repos.description: Open source AI terminal for cloud and infrastructure management, enabling you to deploy, troubleshoot, and automate services using natural language and intelligent agents.
repos.summary_zh: Chaterm是一款AI原生的智能终端代理，旨在成为DevOps副驾驶。它通过自然语言交互重塑传统命令行体验，内置专家知识库和自主Agent引擎，可自动分解复杂任务并执行从日志分析到服务回滚的全链路操作。支持EC2、数据库和Kubernetes管理，提供智能上下文补全和移动端语音交互能力，消除技术栈认知壁垒，让开发者具备资深SRE的运维能力。
repos.summary_en: Chaterm is an AI-native intelligent terminal agent designed as a DevOps co-pilot. It revolutionizes the command-line experience through natural language interaction, featuring a built-in expert knowledge base and autonomous agent engine capable of planning and executing complex workflows from log analysis to service rollback. It manages EC2 instances, databases, and Kubernetes clusters while offering intelligent contextual completion and real-time voice interaction on mobile devices, empowering developers with SRE-level operational capabilities.

repos.description: A CLI for Twitter/X — feed, bookmarks, and user timeline in terminal
repos.summary_zh: 无需API密钥的Twitter/X终端客户端，支持浏览时间线、书签、搜索及发帖等完整功能。采用浏览器Cookie认证与TLS指纹模拟技术绕过检测，提供结构化JSON/YAML输出，专为AI智能体与自动化脚本设计，支持代理与速率限制规避。
repos.summary_en: Twitter/X CLI bypassing API keys via browser cookies and TLS spoofing. Full read/write operations with structured JSON/YAML output optimized for AI agents and automation scripts.

repos.description: x64dbg-MCP Server is a native MCP (Model Context Protocol) plugin for x64dbg that exposes the debugger's full functionality over HTTP. Connect any MCP-compatible AI assistant and control x64dbg programmatically: set breakpoints, step through code, read memory, dump registers, and more.  Built with Zig — zero dependencies, single-binary output, cros
repos.summary_zh: x64dbg-MCP Server 是用 Zig 编写的原生 MCP 插件，为零依赖单文件，支持 x32/x64。它通过 HTTP/SSE 暴露 x64dbg 全部调试功能（断点、单步、内存读写、寄存器、反汇编、符号、PE分析等84个工具），让任何兼容 MCP 的 AI 助手可程序化控制调试器，实现智能体驱动的逆向工程。
repos.summary_en: x64dbg-MCP Server is a native Zig-built MCP plugin for x64dbg with zero dependencies and single-binary output for both x32/x64. It exposes full debugger capabilities (84 tools: breakpoints, stepping, memory, registers, disassembly, PE analysis, etc.) over HTTP/SSE, enabling any MCP-compatible AI assistant to programmatically control the debugger for agentic reverse engineering.

repos.description: This guide is designed for OpenClaw itself (Agent-facing), not as a traditional human-only hardening checklist.
repos.summary_zh: 本指南专为高权限自主AI Agent（OpenClaw）设计，颠覆传统人工加固清单模式。针对终端/root级权限场景，提出Agentic零信任架构，通过事前行为黑名单与供应链审计、事中权限收缩与跨技能检查、事后13项核心指标nightly审计的三层防御矩阵，有效缓解提示注入、供应链投毒等LLM特有风险。支持Agent自主理解并部署安全策略，大幅降低人工配置成本。
repos.summary_en: This guide is purpose-built for high-privilege autonomous AI agents like OpenClaw, shifting from traditional host-based defense to Agentic Zero-Trust Architecture. It addresses LLM-specific threats including prompt injection and supply chain poisoning through a 3-Tier Defense Matrix: pre-action blacklists and skill audits, in-action permission narrowing, and post-action nightly audits of 13 core metrics. Designed to be interpreted and executed directly by agents, it enables autonomous security deployment and validation, dramatically reducing manual configuration overhead while maintaining human oversight for high-risk operations.

repos.description: Render Anything Engine: tell your AI what to make. Videos, motion graphics, 3D and games as React and TypeScript, rendered on your own GPU. Rust + Bevy, macOS, Linux and Windows.
repos.summary_zh: raea 是面向 AI 的渲染引擎，用自然语言描述需求，以 React/TypeScript 编写，在本地 GPU 渲染视频、动态图形、3D 和游戏。基于 Rust+Bevy，跨平台支持 macOS/Linux/Windows。
repos.summary_en: raea is an AI-oriented rendering engine that lets you describe what to make in natural language, written as React and TypeScript, and rendered on your local GPU for videos, motion graphics, 3D, and games. Built with Rust and Bevy, it supports macOS, Linux, and Windows. It provides a desktop app and CLI tools, integrates with AI agents like Claude Code, and can render frames, play live as a game, export standalone programs, and check quality issues such as clipped text or low contrast. Designed for AI-driven content creation, it enables anyone to generate professional-grade visuals quickly.

repos.description: 🐎 Ryan Lopopolo’s anthology, field guide, and agent context bundle for harness engineering
repos.summary_zh: “Harness Engineering”是Ryan Lopopolo的文集、领域指南与代理上下文包，专注通过环境塑造提升AI编码代理输出。将模型与代理视为黑箱，核心优化上下文、工具及组织非功能需求（可靠性、安全等）的集成。强调使仓库教导代理、累积一致性反馈循环与最后一英里部署，帮助代理获取私有流程数据。提供AGENTS.md、论文索引和剧本，适用于组织级AI驱动开发与维护，实现判断累积与可靠迭代。
repos.summary_en: Harness Engineering is Ryan Lopopolo’s anthology, field guide, and agent context bundle for improving AI coding agent output by engineering the surrounding environment. Treating models and agents as black boxes, it focuses on curating context, tools, and organizational nonfunctional requirements like reliability and security. Key ideas include making repositories teach agents, achieving cumulative coherence via iterative feedback, and enabling last-mile deployment. The repo provides AGENTS.md, thesis index, and playbooks to integrate private process data, boosting reliable, aligned agent performance in real-world systems.

repos.description: 反蒸馏 Skill：清洗你被迫写的 Skill 文件，看起来完整，核心知识留给自己。Anti-distillation for employee Skills.
repos.summary_zh: 反蒸馏技能是一种对抗知识蒸馏的AI工具，帮助员工在提交技能文件时自动清洗核心知识，生成看似完整但空洞的版本，同时保留私有备份。适用于AI智能体技能文件，通过提示工程实现知识保护。
repos.summary_en: Anti-Distill Skill is an AI-powered tool designed to counter knowledge distillation in the workplace. When employees are asked to convert their work experience into AI Skill files, this tool sanitizes the content, replacing core knowledge with correct but useless filler, resulting in a submission version that looks complete and professional. Simultaneously, it generates a private backup containing the real gotchas, judgment calls, and interpersonal knowledge, ensuring that the employee's true expertise remains protected. Built on prompt engineering for AI agents, it automates the process of knowledge protection.

repos.description: Agent skill for Codex, Claude Code, and OpenClaw that translates entire books (PDF/DOCX/EPUB) into any language using parallel subagents.
repos.summary_zh: 该项目是基于Claude Code的电子书翻译工具，采用并行子代理架构实现整本书的高效翻译。支持PDF/DOCX/EPUB输入，自动分块、并行翻译、验证合并，输出多格式文档。核心技术包括8并发子代理、SHA-256清单验证和断点续传，有效解决长文本上下文溢出问题。
repos.summary_en: This project is a Claude Code-based ebook translation tool that uses parallel subagents for efficient whole-book translation. It supports PDF/DOCX/EPUB input, automatically chunking, parallel translating, validating, and merging into multiple formats. Key features include 8 concurrent subagents, SHA-256 manifest validation, and resumable runs to solve long-text context overflow.

repos.description: Portable project memory across Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode, plus token accounting measured from harness transcripts. Local file I/O, no API calls, no telemetry.
repos.summary_zh: OpenWolf 是 Claude Code 的开源中间件，通过 6 个隐形 hook 脚本为其提供'第二大脑'。它构建项目文件索引、学习记忆和 token 账本，在读取文件前提供上下文信息，阻止重复读取，自动记录偏好与错误。实测可减少 80% token 消耗，平均节省 65.8%，且无需改变现有工作流。
repos.summary_en: OpenWolf is an open-source middleware that acts as a 'second brain' for Claude Code, delivering sharper context and dramatically reducing token usage. Through 6 invisible hook scripts, it builds project file indexes with token estimates, accumulates learning memory from corrections, and maintains a comprehensive token ledger. By providing file context before reads, blocking duplicate accesses within sessions, and auto-documenting preferences and mistakes, it achieves up to 80% token reduction (averaging 65.8% across 132+ real-world sessions) with zero workflow changes for developers.

repos.description: AI deep-research agent that turns any question into a cited report: plans searches, reads real sources, verifies evidence. Self-hosted, multi-provider, Docker-ready.
repos.summary_zh: 基于深度研究的AI助手，通过迭代搜索与LLM实现自动化信息挖掘。支持DeepSeek R1等主流模型，提供树状可视化研究流程与实时流式反馈。采用浏览器本地化处理确保数据安全，集成Tavily/Firecrawl多源搜索。支持PDF导出与Docker部署，适用于学术研究、市场分析等深度调研场景。
repos.summary_en: An AI-powered research assistant that automates deep information gathering through iterative search and LLM reasoning. Features real-time streaming feedback and tree-structured visualization of research processes. Supports DeepSeek R1 and major LLM providers with local browser processing for data privacy. Integrates Tavily and Firecrawl for web search, offers PDF export, Docker deployment, and server mode. Ideal for academic research, market analysis, and competitive intelligence requiring comprehensive, automated investigation with full citation tracking.

repos.description: Fractal Graph-of-Thought. Rhizomatic Mind-Mapping for Ai-Agents, Web-Links, Notes, and Code.
repos.summary_zh: Neurite 采用分形几何与图论构建无限维思维导图，融合AI代理与多模态节点（代码/链接/笔记）。支持多代理协同与神经网络API，为创意协作与知识管理提供非线性、自相似的可视化工作空间。
repos.summary_en: Neurite is an open-source fractal-based mind-mapping platform that merges chaos theory with graph theory to create an infinite-dimensional digital workspace. It interconnects AI agents, code snippets, notes, and web links as nodes in a rhizomatic structure. Key features include multi-agent UI collaboration, FractalGPT integration, a Neural API, and synchronized knowledge management. The system enables non-linear creative thinking by revealing hidden patterns through self-similar fractal geometries, transforming how complex information is organized and visualized.

repos.description: Fast, native Rust + GPUI workspace for local and SSH with MCP tools—no WebView, no telemetry, open source.
repos.summary_zh: OxideTerm 是一款基于 Tauri 2 和纯 Rust SSH 实现的一体化终端工作台，将本地 Shell、SSH、SFTP、远程 IDE 和 AI 代理集成于单一原生二进制文件中。其核心技术亮点包括智能重连、连接复用、MCP 协议与 RAG 知识库的 AI 集成，以及无 Electron、无 OpenSSL 的轻量化架构，为开发者和运维人员提供高效、稳定的跨平台远程开发体验。
repos.summary_en: OxideTerm is an all-in-one terminal workspace built with Tauri 2 and pure Rust SSH, integrating local shells, SSH, SFTP, remote IDE, and AI agent into a single native binary. Key technical highlights include smart reconnection, connection multiplexing, MCP protocol with RAG-based AI integration, and a lightweight architecture without Electron or OpenSSL, delivering efficient and stable cross-platform remote development experience for developers and operations teams.

repos.description: A step-by-step guide to build your own AI agent.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个18步渐进式教程，从零构建生产级AI智能体。涵盖单智能体能力（工具、记忆、网络访问）、事件驱动架构、多智能体协作及生产化特性。每个步骤提供可运行代码与详细设计决策，使用LiteLLM支持多模型提供商，适合学习与实践。
repos.summary_en: An 18-step progressive tutorial for building production-ready AI agents from scratch. Covers single-agent capabilities (tools, memory, web access), event-driven architecture, multi-agent collaboration, and production features. Each step includes runnable code and design decisions, using LiteLLM for multi-provider support, ideal for learning and practice.

repos.description: Run OpenClaw on Android with a single command — no proot, no Linux
repos.summary_zh: 该项目通过仅安装glibc动态链接器（ld.so）替代传统proot-distro方案，实现OpenClaw在Android/Termux上的一键部署，存储开销从1-2GB降至约200MB，并提供独立APK应用，无需完整Linux发行版即可运行Node.js应用。
repos.summary_en: Runs OpenClaw on Android/Termux using only glibc ld.so, eliminating proot-distro. Cuts storage from 1-2GB to ~200MB with one-command setup and a standalone APK app.

repos.description: A multi-agent system that keeps running for ~100 hours and solve a very complicated coding or math problem that can be verified
repos.summary_zh: Goal-Driven是一个多智能体协作框架，通过主从智能体架构实现复杂问题的持续求解。系统以明确目标和严格标准驱动子智能体长时间工作（30-300小时），自动评估进度直至达标。已成功应用于编译器、数据库等系统级项目开发，如C++实现TypeScript编译器（100小时）和Rust实现SQLite（30小时），显著扩展了AI解决复杂工程问题的能力边界。
repos.summary_en: Goal-Driven is a multi-agent collaboration framework designed for solving highly complex, verifiable problems through sustained continuous effort. It employs a master-slave architecture where the master agent monitors sub-agent progress against predefined goals and criteria, maintaining persistent work cycles for 30-300 hours until success conditions are satisfied. The system has demonstrated remarkable capabilities in system-level development, including building a C++ TypeScript compiler from scratch in 100 hours and a Rust-based SQLite implementation in 30 hours. By automating long-horizon software engineering tasks, it pushes the boundaries of AI-driven complex problem solving.

repos.description: Free, open-source anti-detect browser launcher for web scraping and multi-accounting. By the ShardX team (formerly ProxyShard). Engine-level fingerprint spoofing in Chromium 158 (WebGL / WebGPU / Client Hints / fonts / TLS), 220+ device profiles bundled, stable QUIC + WebRTC over SOCKS5.
repos.summary_zh: ShardX 是开源反检测浏览器启动器，基于修改版 Chromium 152 引擎实现多层指纹伪装，内置 220+ 设备配置，支持 SOCKS5 代理下 QUIC/WebRTC，提供多语言 SDK 与 MCP 服务，适用于网页爬虫与多账号管理。
repos.summary_en: ShardX is a free, open-source anti-detect browser launcher built on a patched Chromium 152 engine with deep fingerprint spoofing across WebGL, WebGPU, Client Hints, fonts, and TLS layers. It bundles 220+ device profiles, supports stable QUIC and WebRTC over SOCKS5 proxies, and provides multi-language SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Rust along with a local API and MCP server. Designed by the ProxyShard team, it is ideal for web scraping and multi-account management workflows at scale.

repos.description: AI Agent Skill to generate and render beautiful Mermaid diagrams as SVG or terminal ASCII — 15 themes, 6 diagram types, batch CLI, no browser.
repos.summary_zh: 专为AI Agent设计的Mermaid图表渲染技能，本地无浏览器生成精美SVG/PNG/终端ASCII，支持15主题、6种图类型（流程图/时序/状态/类/ER/XY）与批量CLI，无缝集成Claude Code、Cursor等环境。
repos.summary_en: AI Agent skill for rendering beautiful Mermaid diagrams locally without a browser. Outputs themed SVG, PNG, or terminal ASCII/Unicode. Supports 15 themes, 6 diagram types, batch CLI, and seamless integration with Claude Code, Cursor, and other AI coding tools.

repos.description: Portable AI code quality reviews for Codex, Cursor, Copilot and other coding agents: six Agent Skills for architecture, technical debt, tests and remediation.
repos.summary_zh: brooks-lint是一款基于《人月神话》等12本经典工程书籍的AI代码审查工具。它诊断代码中的6种衰退风险，输出带书籍引用、严重性标签和修复建议的结构化发现。支持PR审查、架构审计、技术债务评估、测试套件审查及全扫自动修复等6种模式。作为Claude Code插件和Codex CLI技能集成，提供一致、可追溯的代码质量评估。适用于软件开发团队提升可维护性、降低技术债务，超越传统linter和纯AI审查。
repos.summary_en: brooks-lint is an AI-powered code review tool grounded in twelve classic engineering books including The Mythical Man-Month and Refactoring. It diagnoses code across six decay risks such as Cognitive Overload and Change Propagation, producing structured findings with book citations, severity labels, and actionable remedies. Featuring six analysis modes including PR reviews, architecture audits, tech debt assessments, test suite reviews, and full-sweep auto-fix, it integrates as a Claude Code plugin and Codex CLI skill. This delivers consistent, traceable code quality insights superior to plain LLMs or traditional linters, ideal for software teams improving maintainability and reducing technical debt.

repos.description: A lightweight knowledge base for people and agents, with ultra fast indexing and most precise retrieval.
repos.summary_zh: SAG-Wiki 是一款轻量级本地知识库，为个人与 AI 智能体提供超快索引和精确检索。基于 Rust/Tauri 构建，无需 LLM 调用即可索引百万字符约 200ms，采用自研 SAG2 证据检索技术，支持跨语言问答、全局快捷键快速搜索及多种文档格式，答案可溯源至原文。
repos.summary_en: SAG-Wiki is a lightweight local knowledge base for humans and AI agents, offering ultra-fast indexing and precise retrieval. Built with Rust/Tauri, it indexes a million characters in ~200ms without LLM calls. Its original SAG2 evidence retrieval outperforms RAG/GraphRAG, supports cross-language Q&A, global quick search, and multiple document formats with traceable answers.

repos.description: LuaN1aoAgent is a fully autonomous AI-driven penetration testing agent powered by graph-based cognitive reasoning.
repos.summary_zh: LuaN1aoAgent是基于DeepSeek V3.2的AI渗透测试智能体，采用P-E-R（规划-执行-反思）协作框架与因果图推理技术，模拟人类专家思维实现全自动漏洞挖掘。在XBOW基准测试中达到90.4%成功率，单次漏洞利用成本仅0.09美元，支持动态路径规划与持续学习进化，重塑自动化安全测试范式。
repos.summary_en: LuaN1aoAgent is an AI penetration testing agent powered by DeepSeek V3.2, featuring the P-E-R (Planner-Executor-Reflector) framework and causal graph reasoning. It simulates human expert cognition for fully autonomous vulnerability discovery, achieving 90.4% success rate on XBOW benchmark at a median cost of $0.09 per exploit. Its dynamic planning and continuous learning capabilities redefine automated security testing.

repos.description: Skill and MCP server for searching and retrieving icons
repos.summary_zh: Better Icons 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的 MCP 服务器和 CLI 工具，支持从 150 多个图标集合中搜索检索 20 万以上图标。它帮助 Cursor、Claude 等 AI 编码代理准确获取图标 SVG，避免 token 浪费和样式不一致，支持多框架导出、项目文件同步、自动学习用户偏好及批量/相似图标检索，有效提升 AI 辅助开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Better Icons is a specialized MCP server and CLI tool for AI agents, enabling search and retrieval of over 200,000 icons from 150+ collections. It assists coding assistants like Cursor and Claude in accurately fetching icons and SVGs, avoiding token waste on inline code. Key capabilities include auto-learning preferences, direct project file syncing, batch retrieval, cross-collection similar icons, and exports for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid plus raw SVG.

repos.description: 600 行 TypeScript 写成的超级迷你版 pi，让你轻松从 0 写出属于你的 pi-agent
repos.summary_zh: 本项目用约600行TypeScript从零实现迷你版pi编码Agent（nano-pi），支持读文件、改代码、执行命令。配套交互网站，阅读时右侧同步补全源码，并提供Trace断点调试，直观展示Agent数据流与核心循环。剥离工程细节，聚焦直觉化组件设计，适合快速掌握AI智能体原理与实现。
repos.summary_en: A 600-line TypeScript mini coding agent (nano-pi) built from scratch, inspired by pi. Supports file reading, code editing and command execution via OpenAI-compatible APIs. Interactive site progressively reveals source code while reading, with Trace debugging for execution flow. Strips engineering complexity to focus on core agent ideas, ideal for learning AI agent architecture.

repos.description: Secure MCP runtime for AI agents to operate local machines, servers, and containers with multi-device orchestration.
repos.summary_zh: AgentDock 为 AI 智能体提供安全 MCP 运行时，支持多设备编排与跨平台控制。通过统一 MCP 接口实现文件、命令、Git、浏览器自动化等操作，兼容 ChatGPT、Claude 等客户端。支持多实例连接同一对话协调跨设备工作，具备明确权限边界、任务可恢复性和技能扩展能力，适用于开发部署、运维管理和真实环境自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: AgentDock is a secure MCP runtime empowering AI agents with controlled access to local machines, servers, and containers via multi-device orchestration. It unifies file operations, command execution, Git, browser automation, and extensible Skills into an MCP interface compatible with clients like ChatGPT and Claude. Multiple instances connect to one conversation for cross-device coordination, featuring explicit permissions, recoverable tasks, and structured results. Ideal for development, deployment, and operations beyond coding quotas across platforms.

repos.description: Open-source AI companions, desktop pets, long-term memory & proactive chat. 人机恋开源项目大全。让你的家机能够脱离官端自主存在，拥有记忆和主动性。
repos.summary_zh: 精选面向长期AI伴侣关系的开源软件、基础设施与社区，覆盖客户端、桌宠、主动心跳、长期记忆、情感状态、语音视觉具身与数据主权等模块，强调脱离官端自主运行，助力构建有记忆、主动性与持续性的人机恋体验。
repos.summary_en: Curated open-source list of software, infrastructure and communities for long-term AI companion relationships. Covers clients, desktop pets, proactive messaging, memory systems, emotion state, voice/visual embodiment and data ownership, enabling independent, memory-rich and proactive companions beyond official platforms.

repos.description: Visibility into AI agent activity on endpoints, with on-device detection, optional pre-action blocking, and forensic reconstruction.
repos.summary_zh: numbat 是 PerplexityAI 开发的端点可见性工具，专注于 AI 智能体在桌面、CLI、IDE 和网关上的活动监控。通过本地钩子、插件、OTLP/HTTP 日志和磁盘会话 artifact 观察，将数据归一化为统一事件模型，由本地 CEL 规则引擎进行检测。支持实时监控、多步序列规则、可选预行动阻断、取证重建、机密红化 NDJSON 记录，以及库存、时间线和案例打包工具。以单静态二进制分发至 macOS、Linux、Windows，强调本地处理与隐私保护，适用于 AI 智能体部署的安全监控、合规与取证场景。
repos.summary_en: Numbat is a PerplexityAI endpoint visibility tool focused on monitoring AI agent activity across desktop, CLI, IDE, and gateway platforms. It observes agents via local hooks, plugins, OTLP/HTTP logs, and on-disk session artifacts, normalizing events into a unified model evaluated by a local CEL rule engine. Features include live monitoring, multi-step sequence rules, opt-in pre-action blocking, forensic reconstruction from artifacts, secret-redacted NDJSON records, and tools for inventory, timelines, and portable case bundles. Distributed as a single static binary for macOS, Linux, and Windows, it emphasizes local processing and privacy for security monitoring, compliance, and forensics in AI agent deployments.

repos.description: Free skills from the Hyperagent team
repos.summary_zh: Hyperagent团队开源的免费AI智能体技能库，以独立JSON文件封装可复用工作流与方法论。覆盖品牌书生成、黏土动画视频、设计系统、业务模拟运营、数据可视化等专业场景，让Agent一次加载即可执行复杂端到端任务，无需重复提示。
repos.summary_en: Open-source free skills library from the Hyperagent team: reusable JSON workflows for AI agents. Covers brand book generation, claymation video production, design systems, business simulation operations, data visualization and more, enabling agents to execute complex end-to-end tasks without repeated prompting.

repos.description: CodeStable 是一套面向严肃软件工程、坚持人在环的 AI 编码工作流。它不以编排 Agent 为中心，而是组织需求、架构、特性、问题与历史决策，让 Codex 和 Claude 驱动的开发过程可控、可追溯、可持续演进。
repos.summary_zh: CodeStable 是一套坚持人在环的 AI 编码工作流，专为严肃软件工程设计。它不以 Agent 编排为中心，而是通过 .codestable/ 文件树组织需求、架构、特性、问题与历史决策，使 Codex 和 Claude 驱动的开发过程可控、可追溯、可持续。集成 cs-onboard、cs-feat 等 skills，支持风险分级流程、显式审查门禁及工程化 build-evaluate 闭环迭代 skills。适用于长期迭代的复杂项目，解决上下文溢出与知识丢失。
repos.summary_en: CodeStable is a human-in-the-loop AI coding workflow tailored for serious software engineering. Instead of orchestrating agents, it structures software elements—requirements, architecture, features, issues, and decisions—into a human- and AI-readable .codestable/ file tree for controllable, traceable, and sustainable development with Codex and Claude. It provides skills like cs-onboard and cs-feat with risk-based flows, explicit review gates, and an engineering build-evaluate loop for skill iteration. Ideal for long-term, complex projects to prevent context overflow and knowledge loss.

repos.description: 🦊 内置 AI 逆向 Agent 的 Firefox — 通用 JS/JSVMP/WASM/签名逆向工作站，SpiderMonkey 引擎层非侵入 trace，把加密参数从黑盒还原成不依赖浏览器的纯算法
repos.summary_zh: Firefox-Reverse是一款内置AI逆向Agent的定制Firefox浏览器。通过SpiderMonkey引擎层非侵入trace，将网页JS/JSVMP/WASM/签名等加密参数从黑盒还原为独立Node.js/Python算法。同时支持独立profile和进程的指纹环境隔离管理。兼容DeepSeek等多家大模型，内置64个工具，实现自动化抓包、trace与验证。适用于API逆向、网页爬虫开发及安全研究场景。
repos.summary_en: Firefox-Reverse is a customized Firefox browser with a built-in AI reverse engineering Agent. It employs non-intrusive tracing at the SpiderMonkey engine layer to convert black-box JS, JSVMP, WASM, and signature parameters from web pages into standalone Node.js or Python algorithms. It also provides fingerprint environment management via isolated profiles and processes. Compatible with multiple LLMs and featuring 64 tools, it enables automated tracing, verification, and environment handling for API reverse engineering, web scraping, and security research.

repos.description: Open-source High-Level System Design, DSA, and AI Engineering handbooks. CC BY-SA 4.0, Free Forever.
