repos.summary_zh: handbook-academy/engineering-handbook 是开源工程手册仓库，包含两本CC BY-SA 4.0免费手册。HLD手册159章、719 Mermaid图、3100+引用，系统覆盖高阶系统设计、分布式系统与基础设施（从TCP/IP到LLM服务）；DSA手册120章、226图、多语言LeetCode解法，专注数据结构算法与面试实践。内容规模相当于数千页教科书，提供系统化深度学习与职业准备资源。
repos.summary_en: The handbook-academy/engineering-handbook repository hosts two sibling open-source engineering handbooks under CC BY-SA 4.0. The HLD Handbook delivers 159 chapters on high-level system design, distributed systems, and modern infrastructure with 719 Mermaid diagrams and 3,100+ citations. The DSA Handbook covers 120 chapters of data structures and algorithms, including multi-language LeetCode solutions and interactive widgets. Together they provide massive, free curricula equivalent to thousands of pages for deep engineering learning and interview preparation.

repos.description: A Cursor skill that gives AI agents real UI component knowledge — best practices, layout patterns, and design-system conventions for 60+ interface components — so it generates production-grade UI instead of generic output.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个 Cursor AI 技能，为 AI 编程注入 60+ UI 组件的专业设计知识，包括最佳实践、布局模式和设计系统规范。通过消除 AI 的随意猜测，它能自动生成符合现代 SaaS、企业级或创意风格的生产级前端代码，显著提升 UI 开发质量与效率。
repos.summary_en: This Cursor AI skill provides AI agents with deep expertise on 60+ UI components, covering accessibility standards, responsive layout patterns, and design system conventions meticulously curated from component.gallery. It eliminates generic output by delivering specific best practices, common layouts, and anti-patterns for each component, automatically generating production-grade interfaces in five style presets: Modern SaaS, Apple-level Minimal, Enterprise/Corporate, Creative/Portfolio, and Data Dashboard. The result is senior-designer-quality UI code that follows proven patterns without manual template assembly, significantly accelerating frontend development workflows.

repos.description: High-performance native SSH client in Rust, GPU-rendered with GPUI: host manager, terminal, WinSCP-style SFTP and port forwarding. Rust 编写、GPU 渲染的原生 SSH 客户端。
repos.summary_zh: ShellRS 是一款 Rust 编写的高性能跨平台原生 SSH 客户端，基于 GPUI 实现 GPU 渲染界面。集成 Xshell 风格主机管理、WinSCP 风格 SFTP 文件传输及端口转发，支持多级跳板与代理连接，无 Electron 依赖，并提供 CLI 供 AI 智能体调用。
repos.summary_en: ShellRS is a high-performance, cross-platform native SSH client written in Rust, featuring GPU-accelerated rendering powered by the GPUI framework from the Zed editor. It unifies Xshell-style host management, tabbed terminals, WinSCP-style dual-pane SFTP file transfer, and SSH port forwarding into a single integrated window. The client supports multi-level jump hosts, HTTP and SOCKS5 proxy connections, and stores credentials securely in the system keychain. With no Electron or JVM dependencies, it delivers native performance. A built-in CLI tool also enables AI agents like Claude Code to execute commands and transfer files on saved hosts.

repos.description: 基于 11 个内容洞见维度的自媒体创作 Skill，适用于各种智能体  给它一个主题，它给你一篇完整的文章、5 个备选标题、以及每张配图的生成 prompt。
repos.summary_zh: 这个仓库提供了一个基于11个内容洞见维度的AI智能体写作技能，能够根据主题自动生成可直接发布的完整文章、5个备选标题及配图prompt。支持微信公众号、小红书、抖音多平台适配，通过系统性思考框架提升内容深度与传播力，输出结构化Markdown，显著提高创作效率与质量。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a viral writing skill for AI agents based on 11 content insight dimensions. Given a topic, it generates complete articles, 5 alternative titles with strategies, and AI image prompts. It adapts to WeChat, Xiaohongshu, and Douyin platforms with distinct styles, outputs structured Markdown, and enhances content depth and engagement through systematic thinking frameworks.

repos.summary_zh: Oz Skills 是为 Warp AI 代理和 Oz 系统设计的可复用技能库，通过 Markdown 文件定义开发规范与工作流程。技能以 YAML 前置元数据 + 内容的形式存储于 `.agents/skills/` 目录，支持项目级和全局级自动发现加载。该仓库提供预制技能模板，实现 AI 代理的上下文感知能力，显著提升开发协作效率，支持社区贡献扩展。
repos.summary_en: Oz Skills is a curated collection of reusable Agent Skills for Warp AI agents and Oz systems, defining development conventions and workflows through Markdown files. Skills are stored in `.agents/skills/` directories with YAML frontmatter and markdown content, supporting automatic discovery at both project and global levels. This repository provides pre-built skill templates that enable context-aware AI assistance, significantly improving development collaboration efficiency while allowing community contributions.

repos.description: Reusable AI video production skills library for creation, recreation, motion design, openers, and QA.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个长期维护的AI视频制作技能库，沉淀视频创作、复刻、动效设计、片头包装与质检等可复用方法。核心收录证据驱动的参考视频复刻质检（PSNR/SSIM验证）、暗色SaaS魔术短片生成及黑底白字打字开场技能，适用于Codex、Claude Code等AI代理。通过npx skills模块化安装与扩展，按视频类型和环节组织，显著提升专业视频生产效率与像素级质量控制。
repos.summary_en: This is a long-term maintained library of reusable AI video production skills, curating methods for video creation, recreation, motion design, opener packaging, and QA. It includes evidence-driven reference video replica QC with PSNR/SSIM verification, dark SaaS magic UI shorts, and black-white text typing openers. Designed for AI agents like Codex and Claude Code, it supports modular npx skills installation and structured extension by video type and workflow, boosting efficiency and precision in AI-assisted video production.

repos.description: Terminal UI to get stuff done in the browser
repos.summary_zh: Browser Use Terminal 是一个基于 Rust 的终端 UI 工具，用于让 LLM 代理自动化控制浏览器完成真实任务。它通过直接 CDP 连接操作真实 Chrome 会话，支持无头模式和云端执行，提供可交互的终端界面来观察、控制和恢复任务。核心优势在于 2倍成本效益和速度提升，适用于需要认证状态的企业 Web 应用自动化。
repos.summary_en: Browser Use Terminal is a Rust-based TUI that enables LLM agents to automate browser tasks via direct CDP control. It leverages real Chrome sessions with existing login states, supports headless and cloud execution, and offers an interactive interface for task monitoring and intervention. The custom LLM harness achieves 2x cost reduction and performance gains, perfect for complex authenticated web workflows.

repos.summary_en: This repository hosts the 'Learning Beyond Gradients' blog post and all associated reproducible artifacts. The research investigates heuristic learning approaches that transcend traditional gradient-based methods in reinforcement learning, with comprehensive experiments conducted across Atari, MuJoCo, and VizDoom benchmark environments. It delivers production-ready Python implementations leveraging EnvPool for high-performance simulation, complete policy scripts, sample-efficiency visualizations, checkpoint videos, and detailed reproduction commands. The project serves as a valuable resource for AI agent development, reinforcement learning research, and exploring novel heuristic optimization techniques.

repos.summary_zh: 该插件将微信消息通道深度集成至Claude Code，开发者可直接在终端收发微信消息。采用本地MCP服务器与HTTP长轮询技术，无需公网Webhook。通过二维码登录和配对码验证实现安全认证，并针对微信API的context_token机制优化，支持双向消息同步，无缝衔接开发工作流。
repos.summary_en: This plugin deeply integrates WeChat messaging channels into Claude Code, allowing developers to send and receive WeChat messages directly in the terminal without switching contexts. It employs a local MCP server with HTTP long-polling technology, eliminating the need for public webhooks. Features include QR code login, pairing code verification, and optimized handling of WeChat's context_token mechanism for bidirectional message synchronization, seamlessly integrating into developer workflows.

repos.description: Learn everything about world model
repos.summary_zh: 本GitHub仓库是Datawhale的《Learn World Models》开源课程，系统介绍世界模型从直觉到构建的全流程。包括历史演进、VAE编码、RSSM动态、架构对比、规划算法及评估指标等内容，并提供VAE训练、RSSM构建、Dreamer智能体等实践项目。强调动手实现模拟、规划与评估系统，适合AI智能体开发者和强化学习研究者学习。
repos.summary_en: This Datawhale GitHub repository presents the 'Learn World Models' course, offering a structured path from intuition to implementation of world models in AI. It covers historical evolution, VAE encoding, RSSM dynamics, architecture patterns, planning algorithms, and evaluation metrics. Five lectures and five projects enable building VAE encoders, RSSM models, Dreamer agents, and evaluation dashboards. The highlight is combining theory with hands-on practice for simulation, planning, and assessment systems, ideal for AI agent developers and reinforcement learning researchers.

repos.description: Local-first, open-source Claude Science alternative, before Claude Science is a thing. Turn your AI agent into personal DNA expert.
repos.summary_zh: Genomi 是开源 AI 代理运行时，将 AI 代理转变为个人 DNA 专家。它提供本地私有工作空间，包括 Active Genome Index 存储变异数据、公共遗传证据查询、探索记忆和报告工具，实现证据支持的 DNA 问题解答。基因组数据完全本地保留，支持 MCP 兼容主机如 Claude，解析原始 DNA 文件，回答健康风险、药物反应、遗传特征等问题，并随研究自更新。保障隐私的个性化基因组分析。
repos.summary_en: Genomi is an open-source AI agent runtime that turns your AI agent into a personal DNA expert. It provides a private local workspace with an Active Genome Index for variants, public genetics evidence queries, exploration memory, and report tools for evidence-backed answers. Genome data stays on-device. Compatible with MCP hosts like Claude, it parses raw DNA files, enables local querying on health risks, medication responses and traits, and self-updates with latest research for secure, personalized genomic insights.

repos.description: A tiny TypeScript web agent, hill climbed on real browser evals.
repos.summary_zh: 基于Pi Mono与CDP的TypeScript浏览器智能体，通过持久化V8 REPL执行JavaScript控制Chrome，支持会话保持、登录态复用、流式输出与无障碍树交互，适用于网页自动化与数据采集。
repos.summary_en: A lightweight TypeScript web agent built on Pi Mono LLM and raw Chrome DevTools Protocol, using a persistent V8 REPL to execute JavaScript and control Chrome browsers. The agent dynamically writes its own helper functions, supporting session persistence, saved logins, streaming output, typed results, and accessibility-tree interaction. Designed for browser automation, web scraping, and data collection tasks, with cloud browser support requiring no local Chrome installation. Features include ultrafast mode for interaction-heavy tasks, interaction highlights, screen recordings, and GIF exports for visual debugging.

repos.description: 把一篇文章或一条视频（抖音、B 站、YouTube，先转逐字稿）一键做成小红书图文、杂志长图、公众号排版和 AI 配音口播短视频的开源 Claude Code / Codex Skill。21 套主题，自动验收，零 npm 依赖。
repos.summary_zh: 开源 Claude Code / Codex Skill，将文章或视频一键转化为小红书图文、公众号排版、杂志长图及 AI 配音口播短视频。10 个独立能力自由组合，21 套主题，自动验收，零 npm 依赖，仅需 Node.js 22 与 Chrome。
repos.summary_en: Open-source Claude Code / Codex Skill that transforms articles or videos into Xiaohongshu cards, WeChat layouts, magazine long images, and AI-narrated short videos. 10 independent capabilities, 21 themes, automated validation, zero npm dependencies, requiring only Node.js 22 and Chrome.

repos.description: skills for deep search — multi-source search, content extraction, and structured research reports.
repos.summary_zh: 面向 OpenClaw 的生产级搜索 Skills，整合 Brave/Exa/Tavily/Grok 四源并行检索、意图感知评分与自动去重，支持 GitHub/论坛链式引用深挖及反爬内容高保真提取（MinerU 降级），助力 AI 智能体完成结构化深度调研与报告生成。
repos.summary_en: Production-grade OpenClaw Skills for multi-source parallel search (Brave+Exa+Tavily+Grok), intent-aware scoring and deduplication, chain citation tracking across GitHub/forums, and high-fidelity content extraction with MinerU fallback. Enables AI agents to perform deep thread analysis and structured research reports.

repos.description: distill any book down to its spine
repos.summary_zh: SpineDigest 是专为 AI 智能体设计的知识库 CLI 工具，支持将 EPUB、Markdown 和纯文本导入为可移植 .wikg 知识档案，利用大模型提取知识图谱、摘要与实体关系，并提供 URI 驱动的搜索、结构浏览和阅读模式。它将长文档转化为可维护、可导航的知识基地，而非一次性摘要输出，核心价值在于为 AI 代理提供源可追溯的结构化知识访问与上下文打包能力。
repos.summary_en: SpineDigest is a Node.js CLI optimized for AI agents that converts EPUB, Markdown, and text into portable .wikg knowledge archives. It leverages LLMs to extract knowledge graphs, summaries, and entities, exposing the archive via URI-based search, hierarchical structure, and reading modes. The primary artifact is the reusable .wikg file, enabling navigable, source-backed knowledge bases for long documents rather than one-shot summaries, with export options for AI context packing and reuse.

repos.description: An intentionally vulnerable OWASP LLM Top 10 training platform for AI Security, Prompt Injection, RAG Security, Agent Security, and GenAI penetration testing.
repos.summary_zh: LLMVault 是一个故意漏洞的 CTF 风格训练平台，专为 OWASP LLM Top 10（2025）设计。提供 25 个三层实验室：核心层 10 个单类漏洞实验（提示注入、信息泄露、供应链、数据投毒等）；高级层 10 个多轮交互挑战（越狱、Agent 利用、RAG 攻击）；专家层 5 个真实攻击模拟。每实验室结合攻击与防御实践。Docker 就绪、Python 构建，适用于自托管 AI 安全教育与 GenAI 渗透测试。
repos.summary_en: LLMVault is a deliberately vulnerable CTF-style training platform for OWASP LLM Top 10 (2025). It features 25 labs across three tiers: 10 core labs covering prompt injection, sensitive info disclosure, supply chain, data poisoning and more; 10 advanced multi-turn challenges including jailbreaking, agent exploitation and RAG attacks; plus 5 expert labs modeling real-world threats. Each lab pairs exploitation with defenses. Docker-ready and Python-based, ideal for self-hosted AI security education, GenAI penetration testing and hands-on LLM defense training.

repos.description: Paperclip — search, read, and analyze 8M+ biomedical papers from the command line
repos.summary_zh: Paperclip 是一款命令行工具，专为高效检索与分析 800 万+生物医学文献而设计。支持自然语言/正则搜索、并行 AI 阅读、SQL 查询及图表视觉分析，无缝集成 Unix 工具链。可作为 MCP 服务器赋能 AI 智能体，快速完成文献综述、监管文档查询等科研任务。
repos.summary_en: Paperclip is a command-line tool for rapid search and analysis of over 8 million biomedical papers. It enables natural language/regex search, parallel AI reading, SQL queries, and vision-based figure analysis, integrating seamlessly with Unix tools. As an MCP server, it empowers AI agents to efficiently conduct literature reviews and regulatory document queries.

repos.description: Expert-thinking AGENTS.md profiles that teach AI agents to reason like senior scientists and engineers.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库收集503个专家级AGENTS.md配置文件，针对物理、生物、化学、工程等科学与工程领域，教导AI代理像资深从业者一样框架问题、选用工具数据库、评估证据、排查故障模式并规范报告。基于领域深度研究构建，采用开放AGENTS.md标准，兼容Cursor、Claude Code、OpenAI Codex等工具。核心价值是将通用AI转变为领域专精AI科学家，提升科研准确性与专业性，适用于数据分析、实验设计、方法起草和同行评审等场景。
repos.summary_en: This repository curates 503 expert AGENTS.md profiles for scientific and engineering professions, teaching AI agents to reason like senior practitioners by encoding domain-specific problem framing, tool and database selection, evidence evaluation, failure mode detection, and reporting standards. Research-grounded and built to pass field-expert validation, they leverage the open AGENTS.md standard for seamless integration with Cursor, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, and other tools. The core value lies in transforming generalist AI into specialized AI scientists, enhancing precision in research workflows across physics, biology, chemistry, medicine, and engineering.

repos.description: Find your agents errors be fore your real users do
repos.summary_zh: ArkSim 是一款 AI 智能体仿真测试平台，通过 LLM 驱动的虚拟用户模拟真实多轮对话，在上线前自动检测智能体错误。提供 7 大内置评估指标，支持自定义度量，自动分类错误并分级。协议无关，支持 Chat Completions API 和 A2A 协议，生成可视化 HTML 报告，帮助开发者提前发现并修复问题。
repos.summary_en: ArkSim is an AI agent simulation testing platform that uses LLM-powered virtual users to simulate realistic multi-turn conversations, automatically detecting agent errors before deployment. It offers 7 built-in evaluation metrics, supports custom metrics, automatically categorizes and prioritizes failures. Protocol-agnostic, works with Chat Completions API and A2A, generating interactive HTML reports to help developers identify and fix issues proactively.

repos.description: Agent skill for finding unknowns, grilling plans, and reaching shared understanding before implementation
repos.summary_zh: grill-for-unknowns 是一个专为 AI 智能体设计的技能包，核心价值在于实施前系统发现未知（已知已知/未知、未知已知/未知），避免假设错误。它结合文档/源码检查与计划 grilling，区分事实、决策与领域语言，输出共享理解文档（如 launch-packet、ADR）。适用于不熟悉代码库、模糊需求、复杂架构或子代理启动场景。支持 Claude、Codex、Hermes 等平台通过 SKILL.md 快速安装，提供模板与示例提示。
repos.summary_en: grill-for-unknowns is an agent skill that prevents rushed implementation by systematically surfacing unknowns (known knowns, known unknowns, unknown knowns, unknown unknowns) before coding. It combines source/docs inspection with targeted plan grilling to clarify decisions, domain language, and blind spots, then documents shared understanding via templates like launch-packets and ADRs. Ideal for unfamiliar codebases, vague requirements, complex architectures, or failed attempts due to assumptions. Installs as SKILL.md for Claude, Codex, Hermes, and compatible agents.

repos.description: 🤖 An AI-powered desktop automation agent built with Electron &   Next.js - Control your computer like manus, but as a native   desktop app, an ai browser!
repos.summary_zh: 基于Electron与Next.js的AI桌面自动化浏览器，实现类Manus的计算机控制。核心特性：双模式交互（ChatAgent轻量对话/Deep Explore多智能体工作流）、多模态任务执行、可视化定时调度。支持DeepSeek/Qwen/Gemini等AI提供商，集成Tavily/Serper搜索与MCP服务。采用React 19+Zustand架构，提供原生桌面体验，适用于智能办公、研究分析与自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: An AI-powered desktop automation browser built with Electron and Next.js that enables Manus-like computer control through a native application. Key features include dual-mode interaction (ChatAgent for lightweight conversations vs. Deep Explore for multi-agent workflows), multi-modal task execution, and visual scheduling. Supports major AI providers (DeepSeek, Qwen, Gemini, Claude) with integrated search engines (Tavily/Serper) and MCP services. Built on React 19+Zustand architecture, it delivers native desktop experience for intelligent office work, research analysis, and automation scenarios.

repos.description: Open-source network quality monitoring platform with multi-node Ping, TCPing, HTTP, DNS, IPv6 and Traceroute testing.
repos.summary_zh: 开源多节点网络质量监控平台，支持Ping/TCPing/HTTP/DNS/Traceroute/IPv6探测。采用Master+Agent+RabbitMQ架构，基于RuoYi-Vue-Plus、Next.js与Prometheus Blackbox，提供Agent自动上下线、一键部署、IP地理解析及广告系统，助力企业低成本搭建网络运维与测速平台。
repos.summary_en: Open-source multi-node network quality monitoring platform supporting Ping, TCPing, HTTP, DNS, Traceroute and IPv6. Built with Master+Agent+RabbitMQ architecture using RuoYi-Vue-Plus, Next.js and Prometheus Blackbox. Features auto Agent management, one-click deployment, IP geolocation and ad system for low-cost enterprise network ops.

repos.description: Graph database native to the cloud. Embedded, multi-tenant, built on object storage.
repos.summary_zh: NamiDB是一款基于对象存储的云原生图数据库引擎。它将节点和边以列式文件形式存于S3等桶中，桶为唯一真相源，支持Cypher查询。引擎支持嵌入式（如DuckDB）、HTTP服务器或云托管三种模式，利用S3条件写入实现多租户零协调架构。专为AI智能体构建知识图谱设计，成本可归零、备份简单，填补Kùzu归档后的空白。
repos.summary_en: NamiDB is a cloud-native graph database built on object storage. It persists nodes and edges as columnar files in S3 buckets, with the bucket as the single source of truth. It supports Cypher queries and runs embedded like DuckDB, as an HTTP server, or in hosted cloud using the same engine. S3 conditional writes enable multi-tenancy without consensus layers. Ideal for AI agents needing knowledge graphs, it offers zero-cost scaling and simple S3 backups. It fills the gap after Kùzu's archiving.

repos.description: 英译汉翻译润色 · English→Chinese translate & polish skill (英中对照)
repos.summary_zh: 基于叶子南《高级英汉翻译理论与实践》构建的英译汉润色技能，通过七阶段工作流消除翻译腔，支持中英对照输出，可集成于Claude Code等AI智能体，适用于翻译、润色与校对场景。
repos.summary_en: A translation polishing skill for English-to-Chinese, based on Ye Zinan's advanced translation theory. It uses a seven-stage workflow to eliminate translationese, supports bilingual output, and integrates with AI agents like Claude Code for translation, polishing, and proofreading.

repos.description: An AI-assisted newsroom workflow system for event tracking, evidence organization, approval chains, correction handling, and post-publication monitoring.
repos.summary_zh: NewsFlow 是一款 AI 辅助的新闻编辑室工作流系统，专注于新闻生产中高成本、高责任的中间流程。系统通过 AI 智能体实现线索归并、证据结构化、风险审查、签发审批和发布后监测，建立完整的人机协同审核机制。采用 FastAPI+React 技术栈，支持自托管和二次开发，为新闻机构提供可审计、可追溯的数字化协作平台。
repos.summary_en: NewsFlow is an AI-assisted newsroom workflow system focusing on the high-cost, high-responsibility intermediate processes of news production. It employs AI agents to handle lead clustering, evidence structuring, risk assessment, approval chains, and post-publication monitoring, establishing a comprehensive human-in-the-loop review mechanism. Built with FastAPI+React stack, it supports self-hosting and secondary development, providing news organizations with an auditable, traceable digital collaboration platform for editorial governance and fact-checking workflows.

repos.description: 华为云 CodeArts Agent OpenAI 兼容代理 · 多账号轮转 + token 自动续期保活 + 并发控制 + WebUI
repos.summary_zh: 华为云 CodeArts Agent（盘古助手）的 OpenAI 兼容代理，纯 Go 实现无需客户端。支持多账号轮转、Token 自动续期保活、并发控制与 WebUI 管理，内置模型可用性探测、每日签到积分自动领取及工具调用支持，可将华为云盘古大模型无缝接入 OpenAI 生态。
repos.summary_en: OpenAI-compatible proxy for Huawei Cloud CodeArts Agent (Pangu). Pure Go, no client required. Features multi-account rotation, auto token refresh, concurrency control, WebUI, model probing, daily credit auto-claim, and tool calling support for seamless integration with the OpenAI ecosystem.

repos.summary_zh: Eubiota是一个专注于人类微生物组自主发现的模块化智能体平台。它通过协调专业智能体，结合领域工具，执行规划、执行与验证的迭代循环，确保证据严谨性。该平台利用结果驱动优化，加速微生物组领域的机制推理与实验设计，旨在提升科研探索的效率与深度。
repos.summary_en: Eubiota is a modular agentic AI platform designed for autonomous microbiome discovery. It orchestrates specialized agents to execute an iterative cycle of planning, execution, and verification via shared memory, ensuring rigorous evidence grounding. The framework integrates domain-specific tools and employs outcome-driven refinement to accelerate mechanistic reasoning and experimental design in human microbiome research.

repos.description: Multi-Agent Autonomous Medical Collaboration System
repos.summary_zh: MediCareAI-Agent 是一个多Agent自主医疗协作系统，采用患者驱动+AI辅助+医生验证模式。系统通过多路径RAG和外部知识分析实现智能诊断与个性化治疗规划，支持主动康复监测和异常告警。技术栈基于Python 3.12+FastAPI异步后端与React 19前端，兼容多LLM提供商，集成pgvector向量数据库，提供完整的医疗级生产部署方案。
repos.summary_en: MediCareAI-Agent is a multi-agent autonomous medical collaboration system that reimagines healthcare through patient-driven, AI-assisted, and doctor-validated workflows. It enables intelligent diagnosis via multi-path RAG, personalized treatment planning, proactive rehabilitation monitoring, and seamless doctor collaboration. Built on Python 3.12+FastAPI async backend and React 19 frontend, it supports multiple LLM providers, integrates pgvector for medical knowledge retrieval, and delivers production-ready deployment with Docker.

repos.description: Hermes Agent proficiencies: shareable operating-attribute skills for human SOPs/playbooks, agent skill/tool-SOP building, safe publishing, and tidy workspace hygiene.
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库为Hermes AI代理提供可共享熟练度技能，聚焦操作纪律。核心包括人类SOP与playbook创建、代理技能与工具SOP构建（含契约与防护）、安全发布审查及工作区卫生管理。强调运行时行为、审查循环和制品区分，提升代理在真实压力下的可靠性和安全性，避免数据泄露与文件混乱。适用于AI代理开发与自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: Hermes Proficiencies is a collection of shareable skills designed for the Hermes AI agent to instill operational discipline. It includes proficiencies for crafting human-facing SOPs and playbooks, building agent skills and Tool SOPs with invocation contracts and guardrails, conducting thorough publishing reviews to prevent private data leaks, and enforcing workspace hygiene to keep files organized. These skills promote runtime behavior, review loops, and clear distinctions between human and agent artifacts, making the agent more reliable, safe, and effective in real-world development and automation scenarios.
